      if(!customerMatchesProducts(v, c.products || [])) return false;
      if(!nameLike(v, c.nameQ || '')) return false;
      const visits=v.bills?.length || 0;
      if(isFiniteNumber(c.minT) && v.revenue<c.minT) return false;
      if(isFiniteNumber(c.maxT) && v.revenue>c.maxT) return false;
      if(isFiniteNumber(c.minV) && visits<c.minV) return false;
      if(isFiniteNumber(c.maxV) && visits>c.maxV) return false;
      if(isFiniteNumber(c.minA) && v.recency<c.minA) return false;
      if(isFiniteNumber(c.maxA) && v.recency>c.maxA) return false;
      if(isFiniteNumber(c.minAvg) && v.aov<c.minAvg) return false;
      if(isFiniteNumber(c.maxAvg) && v.aov>c.maxAvg) return false;
      return true;
    }

    function applySingleLayerToMap(map, layer){
      const src = cloneCustomerMap(map);
      const out = new Map();
      if(!layer) return src;

      if(layer.type === 'abc'){
        const {byKey} = classifyABCForMap(src, false);
        for(const [k,v] of src){ if(byKey.get(k) === layer.value) out.set(k,v); }
        return out;
      }
      if(layer.type === 'rfm'){
        const {byKey} = classifyRFMForMap(src, false);
        for(const [k,v] of src){ if(byKey.get(k) === layer.value) out.set(k,v); }
        return out;
      }

      for(const [k,v] of src){
        let ok = true;
        if(layer.type === 'recency') {
          const min = Number(layer.min || 0), max = numOrInfinity(layer.max);
          ok = v.recency >= min && v.recency <= max;
        }
        else if(layer.type === 'spend') {
          const min = Number(layer.min || 0), max = numOrInfinity(layer.max);
          ok = v.aov >= min && v.aov <= max;
        }
        else if(layer.type === 'nameColor'){
          ok = getCustomerNameColor(v) === normalizeCustomerNameColor(layer.color);
        }
        else if(layer.type === 'pitchOutcome'){
          ok = getPitchOutcomeCategoryForCustomer(v) === String(layer.category || '');
        }
        else if(layer.type === 'pitchCount'){
          const count = getPitchCountForCustomer(v);
          const min = Number(layer.min || 0), max = numOrInfinity(layer.max);
          ok = count >= min && count <= max;
        }
        else if(layer.type === 'serviceGroup'){
          ok = customerServiceGroups(v).has(String(layer.key || ''));
        }
        else if(layer.type === 'productItem'){
          ok = customerMatchesProductKeys(v, layer.keys || (layer.key ? [layer.key] : []));
        }
        else if(layer.type === 'visitFrequency'){
          const visits = v.bills?.length || 0;
          const min = Number(layer.min || 0), max = numOrInfinity(layer.max);
          ok = visits >= min && visits <= max;
        }
        else if(layer.type === 'totalSpend'){
          const total = Number(v.revenue || 0);
          const min = Number(layer.min || 0), max = numOrInfinity(layer.max);
          ok = total >= min && total <= max;
        }
        else if(layer.type === 'weekday'){
          const bucketKey = layer.bucketKey || 'all';
          ok = (v.bills || []).some(b => {
            const w = weekdayIndexFromDate(b.date);
            if(w !== Number(layer.weekday)) return false;
            if(bucketKey === 'all') return true;
            return dayPeriodKeyFromDate(b.date) === bucketKey;
          });
        }else if(layer.type === 'age'){
          const age = state.ageByOpd.get(v.opd);
          const min = Number(layer.min || 0), max = numOrInfinity(layer.max);
          ok = Number.isFinite(age) && age >= min && age <= max;
        }else if(layer.type === 'advanced'){
          ok = matchesAdvancedLayer(v, layer);
        }else if(layer.type === 'custom' && typeof layer.pred === 'function'){
          ok = !!layer.pred(v);
        }
        if(ok) out.set(k,v);
      }
      return out;
    }

    function mapAfterFilterLayers(limit = null){
      const layers = Array.isArray(state.filterLayers) ? state.filterLayers : [];
      const n = limit == null ? layers.length : Math.max(0, Math.min(limit, layers.length));
      let m = cloneCustomerMap(state.customersMap);
      for(let i=0; i<n; i++){
        m = applySingleLayerToMap(m, layers[i]);
      }
      return m;
    }

    function applyPartyFilterToMap(map){
      let m = cloneCustomerMap(map);
      if(state.partyFilterOpds instanceof Set){
        for(const [k,v] of Array.from(m.entries())){
          if(!state.partyFilterOpds.has(pad4(v.opd || ''))) m.delete(k);
        }
      }
      return m;
    }

    function applySearchToMap(map){
      const q = String(state.tableSearch || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if(!q) return cloneCustomerMap(map);
      const qDigits = onlyDigits(q);
      const out = new Map();
      for(const [k,v] of map){
        const hay = [v.opd || '', v.name || '', v.phone || '', k || ''].join(' ').toLowerCase();
        const phoneDigits = normPhone(v.phone || '');
        if(hay.includes(q) || (qDigits && phoneDigits.includes(qDigits))){
          out.set(k,v);
        }
      }
      return out;
    }

    function currentCustomers(options = {}){
      const includeSearch = options.includeSearch !== false;
      const cacheKey = `${state.filterVersion || 0}|${includeSearch ? 'search' : 'no-search'}`;
      if(state.currentCustomersCache instanceof Map && state.currentCustomersCache.has(cacheKey)){
        return state.currentCustomersCache.get(cacheKey);
      }
      let m = mapAfterFilterLayers();
      m = applyPartyFilterToMap(m);
      if(includeSearch) m = applySearchToMap(m);
      if(!(state.currentCustomersCache instanceof Map)) state.currentCustomersCache = new Map();
      state.currentCustomersCache.set(cacheKey, m);
      return m;
    }

    function getSelectedProductConditions(){
      return [...document.querySelectorAll('#productListContainer > div')].map(r=>{
        const sels = r.querySelectorAll('select'); return {cat:sels[0]?.value||'', sub:sels[1]?.value||''};
      }).filter(x=>x.cat);
    }

    function customerMatchesProducts(v, conds = null){
      const conditions = Array.isArray(conds) ? conds : getSelectedProductConditions();
      if(!conditions.length) return true;
      for(const b of v.bills || []){
        for(const s of normalizeItemsArray(b.items)){
          const {main, sub} = parseItemNames(s);
          for(const c of conditions){ if(c.cat===main && (!c.sub || c.sub===sub)) return true; }
        }
      }
      return false;
    }
    function nameLike(v, q){ if(!q) return true; return (v.name||'').toLowerCase().includes(String(q).toLowerCase().trim()); }

    function numberOrNull(raw, type = 'float'){
      if(raw == null || raw === '') return null;
      const n = type === 'int' ? parseInt(raw,10) : parseFloat(raw);
      return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
    }

    function filterGeneral(){
      const conds = {
        minT: numberOrNull(document.getElementById('minTotal').value,''),
        maxT: numberOrNull(document.getElementById('maxTotal').value,''),
        minV: numberOrNull(document.getElementById('minVisits').value,'int'),
        maxV: numberOrNull(document.getElementById('maxVisits').value,'int'),
        minA: numberOrNull(document.getElementById('minAbsent').value,'int'),
        maxA: numberOrNull(document.getElementById('maxAbsent').value,'int'),
        minAvg: numberOrNull(document.getElementById('minAvg').value,''),
        maxAvg: numberOrNull(document.getElementById('maxAvg').value,''),
        nameQ: document.getElementById('customerName').value || '',
        products: getSelectedProductConditions()
      };

      const parts = [];
      if(isFiniteNumber(conds.minT)) parts.push(`ยอด≥${conds.minT.toLocaleString()}`);
      if(isFiniteNumber(conds.maxT)) parts.push(`ยอด≤${conds.maxT.toLocaleString()}`);
      if(isFiniteNumber(conds.minV)) parts.push(`ครั้ง≥${conds.minV}`);
      if(isFiniteNumber(conds.maxV)) parts.push(`ครั้ง≤${conds.maxV}`);
      if(isFiniteNumber(conds.minA)) parts.push(`ไม่ได้มา≥${conds.minA}`);
      if(isFiniteNumber(conds.maxA)) parts.push(`ไม่ได้มา≤${conds.maxA}`);
      if(isFiniteNumber(conds.minAvg)) parts.push(`AOV≥${conds.minAvg.toLocaleString()}`);
      if(isFiniteNumber(conds.maxAvg)) parts.push(`AOV≤${conds.maxAvg.toLocaleString()}`);
      if(String(conds.nameQ||'').trim()) parts.push(`ชื่อ: ${conds.nameQ.trim()}`);
      if(conds.products.length) parts.push(`สินค้า ${conds.products.length} เงื่อนไข`);

      addFilterLayer({type:'advanced', conds, label: parts.length ? `ขั้นสูง (${parts.join(', ')})` : 'ฟิลเตอร์ขั้นสูง'});
      updateFilterResultsText();
    }
    function resetFilters(){
      document.getElementById('productListContainer').innerHTML='';
      ['minTotal','maxTotal','minVisits','maxVisits','minAbsent','maxAbsent','minAvg','maxAvg','customerName'].forEach(id=> document.getElementById(id).value='');
      clearFilterLayers();
    }

    function computeRFM(){
      const m = currentCustomers();
      return classifyRFMForMap(m, true);
    }

    function renderRFM(){
      const {summary} = computeRFM();
      const tbody = document.querySelector('#rfmTable tbody');
      tbody.innerHTML = summary.map(r=>`
        <tr>
          <td>${esc(r.segTH)}</td>
          <td>${r.n.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${r.pct.toFixed(1)}%</td>
          <td>${Math.round(r.aov).toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${Math.round(r.rec)}</td>
          <td>${Math.round(r.rev).toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td style="text-align:center"><button class="icon-btn" title="ดูรายชื่อ" onclick="applyRFM('${esc(r.segTH)}')">👁</button></td>
        </tr>
      `).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="7" class="sub-muted">ไม่มีข้อมูล</td></tr>`;
    }

    function computeABC(){
      const res = classifyABCForMap(currentCustomers(), true);
      const tagged = res.tagged || [];
      const total = res.totalRevenue || 1;
      const A = res.A || [], B = res.B || [], C = res.C || [];
      const pct = n => tagged.length? (n*100/tagged.length).toFixed(1)+'%':'-';
      const pctRev = v => total? (v*100/total).toFixed(1)+'%':'-';
      const revA = res.revA || 0, revB = res.revB || 0, revC = res.revC || 0;

      document.querySelector('#abcTable tbody').innerHTML = `
        <tr><td>A</td><td>${A.length.toLocaleString()}</td><td>${pct(A.length)}</td><td>${pctRev(revA)}</td><td>${Math.round(revA).toLocaleString()}</td><td style="text-align:center"><button class="icon-btn" onclick="applyABC('A')">👁</button></td></tr>
        <tr><td>B</td><td>${B.length.toLocaleString()}</td><td>${pct(B.length)}</td><td>${pctRev(revB)}</td><td>${Math.round(revB).toLocaleString()}</td><td style="text-align:center"><button class="icon-btn" onclick="applyABC('B')">👁</button></td></tr>
        <tr><td>C</td><td>${C.length.toLocaleString()}</td><td>${pct(C.length)}</td><td>${pctRev(revC)}</td><td>${Math.round(revC).toLocaleString()}</td><td style="text-align:center"><button class="icon-btn" onclick="applyABC('C')">👁</button></td></tr>
      `;

      const topA = A.slice(0,10).map(x=>{
        const v=x.v; return customerNameLinkHtml(v, modalKeyForCustomer(v));
      }).join(', ');
      document.getElementById('abcWho').innerHTML = topA ? `ตัวอย่างชั้น A: ${topA}` : '—';

      return res;
    }

    const recencyBuckets = [
      {label:'0–30', min:0, max:30},
      {label:'31–60', min:31, max:60},
      {label:'61–90', min:61, max:90},
      {label:'91–180', min:91, max:180},
      {label:'181–365', min:181, max:365},
      {label:'365 ขึ้นไป', min:365, max:Infinity}
    ];
    function renderRecencyDistribution(){
      const cust = [...currentCustomers().values()];
      const totalN = cust.length||1;
      const rows = recencyBuckets.map(b=>{
        const inBucket = cust.filter(v=> v.recency>=b.min && v.recency<=b.max);
        const n = inBucket.length;
        const pct = (n*100/totalN).toFixed(1);
        const avgAOV = n? Math.round(inBucket.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.aov||0),0)/n) : 0;
        const sumRev = Math.round(inBucket.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.revenue||0),0));
        return {b, n, pct, avgAOV, sumRev};
      });

      const tb = document.querySelector('#recencyTable tbody');
      tb.innerHTML = rows.map(r=>`
        <tr>
          <td>${r.b.label}</td>
          <td>${r.n.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${r.pct}%</td>
          <td>${r.avgAOV.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${r.sumRev.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td style="text-align:center">
            <button class="icon-btn" title="ดูรายชื่อ" onclick='applyRecency(${inlineNumberLiteral(r.b.min)},${inlineNumberLiteral(r.b.max)},"${r.b.label}")'>👁</button>
          </td>
        </tr>
      `).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="6" class="sub-muted">ไม่มีข้อมูล</td></tr>`;
    }

    const spendBands = [
      {label:'0–2,000', min:0, max:2000},
      {label:'2,001–5,000', min:2001, max:5000},
      {label:'5,001–10,000', min:5001, max:10000},
      {label:'10,001–15,000', min:10001, max:15000},
      {label:'15,001–20,000', min:15001, max:20000},
      {label:'≥ 20,001', min:20001, max:Infinity}
    ];
    function renderSpendBands(){
      const cust = [...currentCustomers().values()];
      const totalN = cust.length||1;
      const rows = spendBands.map(b=>{
        const inBand = cust.filter(v=> v.aov>=b.min && v.aov<=b.max);
        const n = inBand.length;
        const pct = (n*100/totalN).toFixed(1);
        const avgPerPerson = n? Math.round(inBand.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.aov||0),0)/n) : 0;
        const sumRev = Math.round(inBand.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.revenue||0),0));
        return {b,n,pct,avgPerPerson,sumRev};
      });
      const tb = document.querySelector('#spendBandTable tbody');
      tb.innerHTML = rows.map(r=>`
        <tr>
          <td>${r.b.label}</td>
          <td>${r.n.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${r.pct}%</td>
          <td>${r.avgPerPerson.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${r.sumRev.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td style="text-align:center"><button class="icon-btn" title="ดูรายชื่อ" onclick="applySpend(${inlineNumberLiteral(r.b.min)}, ${inlineNumberLiteral(r.b.max)}, '${r.b.label}')">👁</button></td>
        </tr>
      `).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="6" class="sub-muted">ไม่มีข้อมูล</td></tr>`;
    }

    function renderWeekdayRevenueStats(){
      const cust = [...currentCustomers().values()];
      const emptyStat = () => ({customers:new Set(), bills:0, revenue:0});
      const addStat = (target, key, amount) => {
        target.customers.add(key);
        target.bills += 1;
        target.revenue += amount;
      };
      const mergeStat = (target, source) => {
        (source.customers || new Set()).forEach(k => target.customers.add(k));
        target.bills += source.bills || 0;
        target.revenue += source.revenue || 0;
      };

      const rows = weekdayNamesTH.map((name, idx) => {
        const base = {
          weekday: idx,
          name,
          d1_10: emptyStat(),
          d11_20: emptyStat(),
          d21_end: emptyStat(),
          row_total: emptyStat(),
        };

        cust.forEach(v => {
          (v.bills || []).forEach(b => {
            const w = weekdayIndexFromDate(b.date);
            if(w !== idx) return;
            const amount = recordAmount(b);
            const pkey = dayPeriodKeyFromDate(b.date);
            if(base[pkey]) addStat(base[pkey], v.key, amount);
            addStat(base.row_total, v.key, amount);
          });
        });
        return base;
      });

      const colTotals = {
        label: 'รวมทั้งหมด',
        d1_10: emptyStat(),
        d11_20: emptyStat(),
        d21_end: emptyStat(),
        row_total: emptyStat(),
      };
      rows.forEach(row => {
        ['d1_10','d11_20','d21_end','row_total'].forEach(k => mergeStat(colTotals[k], row[k]));
      });

      const renderCell = (stat, onClick = '', extraClass = '') => {
        if(!stat || !stat.bills){
          return `<td class="${extraClass}"><span class="stat-empty">-</span></td>`;
        }
        const clickable = onClick ? ' clickable-stat' : '';
        const clickAttr = onClick ? ` onclick="${onClick}"` : '';
        return `
          <td class="${clickable} ${extraClass}"${clickAttr}>
            <div class="stat-main">${stat.customers.size.toLocaleString()} คน / ${stat.bills.toLocaleString()} บิล</div>
            <div class="stat-sub">${Math.round(stat.revenue).toLocaleString()} บาท</div>
          </td>`;
      };

      const tb = document.querySelector('#weekdayStatsTable tbody');
      if(!tb) return;

      const bodyRows = rows.map(row => `
        <tr>
          <td style="font-weight:900;color:#064e3b;">${esc(row.name)}</td>
          ${renderCell(row.d1_10, `applyWeekdayDetail(${row.weekday}, 'd1_10', '${esc(row.name)} วันที่ 1–10')`)}
          ${renderCell(row.d11_20, `applyWeekdayDetail(${row.weekday}, 'd11_20', '${esc(row.name)} วันที่ 11–20')`)}
          ${renderCell(row.d21_end, `applyWeekdayDetail(${row.weekday}, 'd21_end', '${esc(row.name)} วันที่ 21–สิ้นเดือน')`)}
          ${renderCell(row.row_total, `applyWeekdayDetail(${row.weekday}, 'all', '${esc(row.name)} รวมรายวัน')`, 'stat-total-col')}
        </tr>
      `).join('');

      const totalRow = `
        <tr class="stat-total-row">
          <td>รวมทั้งหมด</td>
          ${renderCell(colTotals.d1_10, '', '')}
          ${renderCell(colTotals.d11_20, '', '')}
          ${renderCell(colTotals.d21_end, '', '')}
          ${renderCell(colTotals.row_total, '', 'stat-total-col')}
        </tr>
      `;

      tb.innerHTML = bodyRows + totalRow;
    }

    function renderAgeRangeStats(){
      const cust = [...currentCustomers().values()];
      const withAge = cust.filter(v => Number.isFinite(state.ageByOpd.get(v.opd)));
      const rows = ageBuckets.map(b => {
        const inBucket = withAge.filter(v => {
          const age = state.ageByOpd.get(v.opd);
          return age >= b.min && age <= b.max;
        });

        const customers = inBucket.length;
        const bills = inBucket.reduce((s,v)=>s+(v.bills?.length||0),0);
        const revenue = inBucket.reduce((s,v)=>s+(v.revenue||0),0);
        const aov = bills ? Math.round(revenue / bills) : 0;

        return { b, customers, bills, revenue, aov };
      });

      const tb = document.querySelector('#ageStatsTable tbody');
      if(!tb) return;
      tb.innerHTML = rows.map(r => `
        <tr>
          <td style="font-weight:900;color:#064e3b;">${esc(r.b.label)}</td>
          <td>${r.customers.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${r.bills.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${Math.round(r.revenue).toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${r.aov.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td style="text-align:center">
            <button class="icon-btn" type="button" title="ดูรายชื่อ" onclick="applyAgeBucket(${inlineNumberLiteral(r.b.min)}, ${inlineNumberLiteral(r.b.max)}, '${r.b.label}')">👁</button>
          </td>
        </tr>
      `).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="6" class="sub-muted">ไม่มีข้อมูลอายุ</td></tr>`;

      const note = document.getElementById('ageStatsNote');
      if(note){
        const total = cust.length;
        const usable = withAge.length;
        note.textContent = `ใช้ข้อมูลอายุได้ ${usable.toLocaleString()} จาก ${total.toLocaleString()} รายในกลุ่มที่แสดงอยู่`;
      }
    }


    function closeCrmMovedView(){
      const workspace = document.getElementById('customerListWorkspace');
      const panel = document.getElementById('crmMovedPanel');
      workspace?.classList.remove('crm-active');
      panel?.classList.remove('active');
      document.querySelectorAll('.crm-moved-tab').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
      window.CustomerListCRM3?.close?.();
    }

    function setMainView(view){
      closeCrmMovedView();
      state.dashboardProductMenuOpen = false;
      state.productTabProductMenuOpen = false;
      renderDashboardProductPicker();
      renderProductTabProductPicker();
      const target = (view === 'product' || view === 'party' || view === 'price') ? view : 'finance';
      document.querySelectorAll('.view-tab').forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.view === target));
      document.getElementById('financeView')?.classList.toggle('active', target === 'finance');
      document.getElementById('productView')?.classList.toggle('active', target === 'product');
      document.getElementById('partyView')?.classList.toggle('active', target === 'party');
      document.getElementById('priceView')?.classList.toggle('active', target === 'price');
      if(target === 'product') renderProductInsight();
      if(target === 'party') { refreshPartyFocus().catch(()=>{}); renderPartyFocus(); }
      if(target === 'price') renderProductPriceSettings();
    }

    function openCrmMovedView(tab){
      const btn = document.querySelector(`.crm-moved-tab[data-crm-tab="${tab}"]`);
      const workspace = document.getElementById('customerListWorkspace');
      const panel = document.getElementById('crmMovedPanel');
      if(!btn || !workspace || !panel) return;
      document.querySelectorAll('.crm-moved-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn));
      document.querySelectorAll('.view-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelectorAll('.view-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
      workspace.classList.add('crm-active');
      panel.classList.add('active');
      window.CustomerListCRM3?.open?.(tab);
    }

    function initViewTabs(){
      document.querySelectorAll('.view-tab').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => setMainView(btn.dataset.view));
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.crm-moved-tab').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => openCrmMovedView(btn.dataset.crmTab));
      });
      const toolsMenu = document.getElementById('customerToolsMenu');
      toolsMenu?.querySelectorAll('.view-tab').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => { toolsMenu.open = false; });
      });
      document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if(toolsMenu?.open && !toolsMenu.contains(event.target)) toolsMenu.open = false;
      });
      const initialCrmTab = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('crm_tab');
      if(initialCrmTab) openCrmMovedView(initialCrmTab);
    }

    function populateProductInsightSelectors(){
      const catSel = document.getElementById('productCategorySelect');
      const subSel = document.getElementById('productSubSelect');
      if(!catSel || !subSel) return;
      const current = catSel.value;
      catSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">เลือกหมวดสินค้า</option>' +
        Object.keys(productCategories).map(c => `<option value="${esc(c)}">${esc(c)}</option>`).join('');
      if(current && productCategories[current]) catSel.value = current;
      updateProductSubOptions();
    }

    function updateProductSubOptions(){
      const catSel = document.getElementById('productCategorySelect');
      const subSel = document.getElementById('productSubSelect');
      if(!catSel || !subSel) return;
      const cat = catSel.value || '';
      const subs = productCategories[cat] || [];
      subSel.disabled = !cat;
      subSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">ทั้งหมดในหมวด</option>' +
        subs.map(x => `<option value="${esc(x)}">${esc(x)}</option>`).join('');
      state.productTabSelectedProductKeys = new Set();
      state.productTabProductSearch = '';
      renderProductTabProductPicker();
    }

    function normalizeProductCompare(s){
      return String(s || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,' ');
    }

    function productItemMatches(parsed, category, sub){
      if(!category) return false;
      const main = normalizeProductCompare(parsed.main || '');
      const cat = normalizeProductCompare(category);
      if(main !== cat) return false;
      if(!sub) return true;
      const subNeed = normalizeProductCompare(sub);
      const candidates = [parsed.sub, parsed.display, parsed.label].map(normalizeProductCompare);
      return candidates.includes(subNeed) || candidates.some(x => x && x.includes(subNeed));
    }

    function productItemDisplayName(parsed){
      return parsed.sub || parsed.display || parsed.label || '-';
    }

    function productPriceKey(category, productName){
      return `${normalizeProductCompare(category)}|${normalizeProductCompare(productName)}`;
    }

    function getEstimatedUnitPrice(category, productName){
      const key = productPriceKey(category, productName);
      const row = state.productPriceMap.get(key);
      const n = Number(row?.estimated_price || 0);
      return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : 0;
    }
    function getProductCatalogRow(category, productName){
      return state.productPriceMap.get(productPriceKey(category, productName)) || null;
    }

    function productNeedsPriceAttention(category, productName){
      const row = getProductCatalogRow(category, productName);
      if(!row) return true;
      const n = Number(row.estimated_price || 0);
      return !(Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0);
    }

    function legacyWarnButton(category, productName, extraClass=''){
      if(!productNeedsPriceAttention(category, productName)) return '';
      return `<button class="legacy-warn-btn ${extraClass}" type="button" title="เพิ่ม/ใส่ราคาประเมินใน Setting" onclick="event.stopPropagation();openLegacyProductModal('${esc(category)}','${esc(productName)}')">⚠️</button>`;
    }


    function productLineRevenue(parsed, billAmount, itemCountInBill){
      const q = Number(parsed.qty || 1) || 1;
      const productName = productItemDisplayName(parsed);
      const unitPrice = getEstimatedUnitPrice(parsed.main || '', productName);
      return q * unitPrice;
    }

    function getProductScope(){
      return {
        category: document.getElementById('productCategorySelect')?.value || '',
        sub: document.getElementById('productSubSelect')?.value || '',
        q: String(document.getElementById('productSearchInput')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase()
      };
    }

    function buildProductInsightRows(category, sub){
      const customers = [...state.customersMap.values()];
      const resultMap = new Map();
      const brandMap = new Map();
      let latestDateAll = '';

      customers.forEach(v => {
        const matchedLines = [];
        const itemAgg = new Map();
        let qtyTotal = 0;
        let revenueTotal = 0;
        let latestDate = '';
        let matchBillCount = 0;

        (v.bills || []).forEach(b => {
          const items = normalizeItemsArray(b.items).map(parseSaleItem);
          const matched = items.filter(it => productItemMatches(it, category, sub));
          if(!matched.length) return;
          matchBillCount += 1;
          const d = String(b.date || '').slice(0,10);
          if(d && (!latestDate || d > latestDate)) latestDate = d;
          if(d && (!latestDateAll || d > latestDateAll)) latestDateAll = d;

          matched.forEach(it => {
            const name = productItemDisplayName(it);
            const qty = Number(it.qty || 1) || 1;
            const rev = productLineRevenue(it, recordAmount(b), items.length);
            qtyTotal += qty;
            revenueTotal += rev;
            const ag = itemAgg.get(name) || {name, qty:0, revenue:0};
            ag.qty += qty;
            ag.revenue += rev;
            itemAgg.set(name, ag);

            const brand = brandMap.get(name) || {name, customers:new Set(), bills:0, qty:0, revenue:0, latestDates:[]};
            brand.customers.add(v.key);
            brand.bills += 1;
            brand.qty += qty;
            brand.revenue += rev;
            if(d) brand.latestDates.push(d);
            brandMap.set(name, brand);

            matchedLines.push({
              date: d,
              label: name,
              qty,
              revenue: rev,
              billAmount: recordAmount(b),
              note: b.note || '',
              rawBill: b
            });
          });
        });

        if(qtyTotal > 0){
          const lastDt = parseYmdLocal(latestDate);
          const anchor = state.endAnchorDate || new Date();
          const daysSinceProduct = lastDt ? Math.floor((anchor - lastDt)/(1000*60*60*24)) : null;
          const itemSummary = [...itemAgg.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.qty-a.qty).map(x => `${x.name} ${x.qty}`);
          const row = {
            key: v.key,
            v,
            latestDate,
            daysSinceProduct,
            qtyTotal,
            revenueTotal,
            itemSummary,
            matchBillCount,
            lines: matchedLines.sort((a,b)=>String(b.date||'').localeCompare(String(a.date||'')))
          };
          resultMap.set(v.key, row);
        }
      });

      const anchor = state.endAnchorDate || new Date();
      const brandRows = [...brandMap.values()].map(b => {
        const uniqueLatest = new Map();
        b.latestDates.forEach(d => { if(d) uniqueLatest.set(d, d); });
        const daysArr = [...uniqueLatest.values()].map(d => {
          const dt = parseYmdLocal(d);
          return dt ? Math.floor((anchor - dt)/(1000*60*60*24)) : null;
        }).filter(x => Number.isFinite(x));
        const avgDays = daysArr.length ? Math.round(daysArr.reduce((s,x)=>s+x,0) / daysArr.length) : null;
        return {
          name: b.name,
          customers: b.customers.size,
          qty: b.qty,
          revenue: b.revenue,
          avgDays
        };
      }).sort((a,b)=> (b.qty-a.qty) || (b.revenue-a.revenue));

      return {
        customerRows: [...resultMap.values()].sort((a,b)=>String(b.latestDate||'').localeCompare(String(a.latestDate||'')) || (b.qtyTotal-a.qtyTotal)),
        brandRows,
        latestDateAll
      };
    }

    function applyProductTextSearch(rows, q){
      if(!q) return rows;
      const qDigits = onlyDigits(q);
      return rows.filter(r => {
        const hay = [r.v.opd || '', r.v.name || '', r.v.phone || '', r.itemSummary.join(' ')].join(' ').toLowerCase();
        const phoneDigits = normPhone(r.v.phone || '');
        return hay.includes(q) || (qDigits && phoneDigits.includes(qDigits));
      });
    }

    const productGapBuckets = [
      { label:'ไม่เกิน 2 เดือน', min:0, max:60 },
      { label:'2–4 เดือน', min:61, max:120 },
      { label:'4–6 เดือน / ครึ่งปี', min:121, max:180 },
      { label:'6 เดือน–1 ปี', min:181, max:365 },
      { label:'มากกว่า 1 ปี', min:366, max:Infinity }
    ];

    function buildProductGapRows(customerRows){
      return productGapBuckets.map(b => {
        const rows = customerRows.filter(r => {
          const d = r.daysSinceProduct;
          return Number.isFinite(d) && d >= b.min && d <= b.max;
        });
        return {
          label: b.label,
          min: b.min,
          max: b.max,
          customers: rows.length,
          qty: rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+(r.qtyTotal||0),0),
          revenue: rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+(r.revenueTotal||0),0)
        };
      });
    }

    function sortProductCustomerRows(rows){
      const sort = state.productSort || {key:'latest', dir:-1};
      const key = sort.key || 'latest';
      const dir = sort.dir || 1;
      const val = (r) => {
        if(key === 'opd') return String(r.v.opd || '');
        if(key === 'name') return String(r.v.name || '').toLowerCase();
        if(key === 'latest') return r.latestDate || '';
        if(key === 'days') return Number.isFinite(r.daysSinceProduct) ? r.daysSinceProduct : 999999;
        if(key === 'qty') return Number(r.qtyTotal || 0);
        if(key === 'items') return String((r.itemSummary || []).join(' ')).toLowerCase();
        return '';
      };
      return [...rows].sort((a,b)=>{
        const A = val(a), B = val(b);
        let cmp = 0;
        if(typeof A === 'number' && typeof B === 'number') cmp = A - B;
        else cmp = A > B ? 1 : A < B ? -1 : 0;
        if(cmp === 0){
          const ao = String(a.v.opd || ''), bo = String(b.v.opd || '');
          if(ao !== bo) return ao > bo ? 1 : -1;
          return String(a.v.name || '').localeCompare(String(b.v.name || ''), 'th');
        }
        return cmp * dir;
      });
    }

    function updateProductSortHeaders(){
      const sort = state.productSort || {key:'latest', dir:-1};
      document.querySelectorAll('#productCustomersTable thead th[data-product-sort]').forEach(th => {
        const active = th.dataset.productSort === sort.key;
        th.classList.toggle('product-sort-active', active);
        th.setAttribute('data-sort-arrow', active ? (sort.dir === 1 ? ' ↑' : ' ↓') : ' ↕');
      });
    }

    function setProductSort(key){
      if(state.productSort && state.productSort.key === key) state.productSort.dir = -state.productSort.dir;
      else state.productSort = {key, dir: (key === 'latest' || key === 'qty' || key === 'days') ? -1 : 1};
      renderProductInsight();
    }

    function renderProductInsight(){
      const {category, sub, q} = getProductScope();
      const note = document.getElementById('productAppliedNote');
      const brandTb = document.querySelector('#productBrandTable tbody');
      const gapTb = document.querySelector('#productGapTable tbody');
      const custTb = document.querySelector('#productCustomersTable tbody');
      if(!brandTb || !gapTb || !custTb) return;

      if(!category){
        ['prodKpiCustomers','prodKpiQty','prodKpiRevenue','prodKpiAvgDays','prodKpiLatestDate'].forEach(id => {
          const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.textContent='-';
        });
        brandTb.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="5" class="product-empty">เลือกหมวดสินค้าเพื่อเริ่มดูข้อมูล</td></tr>`;
        gapTb.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="4" class="product-empty">เลือกหมวดสินค้าเพื่อเริ่มดูข้อมูล</td></tr>`;
        custTb.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" class="product-empty">เลือกหมวดสินค้าเพื่อเริ่มดูข้อมูล</td></tr>`;
        if(note){ note.textContent = 'เลือกหมวดสินค้าเพื่อเริ่มดูข้อมูล'; note.style.display='block'; }
        state.productResultsMap = new Map();
        updateProductSortHeaders();
        return;
      }

      const built = buildProductInsightRows(category, sub);
      let customerRows = applyProductTextSearch(built.customerRows, q);
      const gapRows = buildProductGapRows(customerRows);
      customerRows = sortProductCustomerRows(customerRows);

      state.productResultsMap = new Map(customerRows.map(r => [r.key, r]));
      state.productBrandRows = built.brandRows;
      state.productGapRows = gapRows;
      state.productCustomerRows = customerRows;

      const totalCustomers = customerRows.length;
      const totalQty = customerRows.reduce((s,r)=>s+(r.qtyTotal||0),0);
      const totalRevenue = customerRows.reduce((s,r)=>s+(r.revenueTotal||0),0);
      const dayVals = customerRows.map(r=>r.daysSinceProduct).filter(x=>Number.isFinite(x));
      const avgDays = dayVals.length ? Math.round(dayVals.reduce((s,x)=>s+x,0)/dayVals.length) : null;
      const latest = customerRows.map(r=>r.latestDate).filter(Boolean).sort().pop() || '';

      const setTxt = (id, val) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.textContent = val; };
      setTxt('prodKpiCustomers', totalCustomers.toLocaleString());
      setTxt('prodKpiQty', Math.round(totalQty).toLocaleString());
      setTxt('prodKpiRevenue', Math.round(totalRevenue).toLocaleString());
      setTxt('prodKpiAvgDays', avgDays == null ? '-' : avgDays.toLocaleString());
      setTxt('prodKpiLatestDate', latest ? formatDate(latest) : '-');

      if(note){
        const scopeText = sub ? `${category} / ${sub}` : `${category} / ทั้งหมดในหมวด`;
        note.textContent = `กำลังดู: ${scopeText} • ช่วงวันที่ ${formatDate(document.getElementById('startDate')?.value || '') || '-'} ถึง ${formatDate(document.getElementById('endDate')?.value || '') || '-'}`;
        note.style.display='block';
      }

      brandTb.innerHTML = built.brandRows.map(r => `
        <tr class="clickable-row" onclick="selectProductBrand('${esc(r.name)}')">
          <td style="font-weight:900;color:#064e3b;">${esc(r.name)}${legacyWarnButton(category, r.name)}</td>
          <td>${r.customers.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${Math.round(r.qty).toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${Math.round(r.revenue).toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${r.avgDays == null ? '-' : r.avgDays.toLocaleString() + ' วัน'}</td>
        </tr>
      `).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="5" class="product-empty">ไม่พบรายการย่อยในหมวดนี้</td></tr>`;

      gapTb.innerHTML = gapRows.map(r => `
        <tr>
          <td style="font-weight:900;color:#064e3b;">${esc(r.label)}</td>
          <td>${r.customers.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${Math.round(r.qty).toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${Math.round(r.revenue).toLocaleString()}</td>
        </tr>
      `).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="4" class="product-empty">ไม่มีข้อมูลระยะห่าง</td></tr>`;

      custTb.innerHTML = customerRows.map(r => {
        const chips = r.itemSummary.slice(0,5).map(x=>{
          const cleanName = String(x || '').replace(/\s+[0-9.]+$/, '');
          return `<span class="product-chip">${esc(x)}${legacyWarnButton(category, cleanName, 'small')}</span>`;
        }).join('');
        const more = r.itemSummary.length > 5 ? `<span class="product-chip">+${r.itemSummary.length-5}</span>` : '';
        return `
          <tr>
            <td>${esc(r.v.opd || '-')}</td>
            <td><a class="link" href="javascript:;" onclick="openProductHistory('${esc(r.key)}')">${esc(r.v.name || '-')}</a></td>
            <td>${r.latestDate ? formatDate(r.latestDate) : '-'}</td>
            <td>${r.daysSinceProduct == null ? '-' : r.daysSinceProduct.toLocaleString() + ' วัน'}</td>
            <td>${Math.round(r.qtyTotal).toLocaleString()}</td>
            <td>${chips}${more}</td>
            <td><button class="icon-btn" type="button" onclick="openProductHistory('${esc(r.key)}')">ดู</button></td>
          </tr>`;
      }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="7" class="product-empty">ไม่พบลูกค้าที่ตรงกับเงื่อนไขสินค้า</td></tr>`;

      updateProductSortHeaders();
    }

    function selectProductBrand(name){
      const subSel = document.getElementById('productSubSelect');
      if(!subSel) return;
      const options = [...subSel.options];
      const found = options.find(o => normalizeProductCompare(o.value) === normalizeProductCompare(name));
      if(found){ subSel.value = found.value; }
      else{
        subSel.innerHTML += `<option value="${esc(name)}">${esc(name)}</option>`;
        subSel.value = name;
      }
      renderProductInsight();
      document.getElementById('productCustomersTable')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
    }

    function defaultUnitForProductModal(category){
      return defaultUnitForCategory(category || '') || 'ชิ้น';
    }

    function openLegacyProductModal(category, productName){
      const modal = document.getElementById('legacyProductModal');
      if(!modal) return;
      const name = String(productName || '').trim();
      const cat = String(category || '').trim();
      state.legacyProductDraft = {category: cat, productName: name};

      const nameText = document.getElementById('legacyProductNameText');
      if(nameText) nameText.textContent = name || '-';

      const catSel = document.getElementById('legacyProductCategory');
      if(catSel){
        const cats = Object.keys(productCategories || {});
        catSel.innerHTML = cats.map(c => `<option value="${esc(c)}">${esc(c)}</option>`).join('');
        if(cat && cats.includes(cat)) catSel.value = cat;
      }

      const row = getProductCatalogRow(cat, name);
      const unitSel = document.getElementById('legacyProductUnit');
      if(unitSel) unitSel.value = row?.unit_label || defaultUnitForProductModal(cat);
      const priceInput = document.getElementById('legacyProductPrice');
      if(priceInput) priceInput.value = row?.estimated_price ? String(row.estimated_price) : '';
      const openSales = document.getElementById('legacyProductOpenSales');
      if(openSales) openSales.checked = row?.is_active === true;

      modal.style.display = 'flex';
      setTimeout(()=>{ try{ document.getElementById('legacyProductPrice')?.focus(); }catch(e){} }, 50);
    }

    function closeLegacyProductModal(event){
      if(event && event.target && event.target.id !== 'legacyProductModal') return;
      const modal = document.getElementById('legacyProductModal');
      if(modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
      state.legacyProductDraft = null;
    }

    async function saveLegacyProductFromInsight(){
      const draft = state.legacyProductDraft || {};
      const category = document.getElementById('legacyProductCategory')?.value || draft.category || '';
      const productName = draft.productName || '';
      const price = document.getElementById('legacyProductPrice')?.value || '';
      const unit = document.getElementById('legacyProductUnit')?.value || 'ชิ้น';
      const openSales = !!document.getElementById('legacyProductOpenSales')?.checked;

      if(!category) return toast('กรุณาเลือกหมวด', 'warn');
      if(!productName) return toast('ไม่พบชื่อสินค้า', 'err');
      if(price === '' || Number(price) < 0) return toast('กรุณาใส่ราคาประเมิน', 'warn');

      try{
        showLoading(true);
        const res = await fetch('/api/products_add_from_insight', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'},
          body: JSON.stringify({category, product_name: productName, estimated_price: Number(price || 0), estimated_unit: unit, open_for_sales: openSales})
        });
        const data = await res.json().catch(()=>({}));
        if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'save_failed');
        await loadProductEstimatedPrices();
        closeLegacyProductModal();
        renderProductInsight();
        toast('เพิ่ม/อัปเดตราคาประเมินแล้ว', 'ok');
      }catch(e){
        console.error(e);
        toast('บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ: ' + (e.message || e), 'err', 3600);
      }finally{
        showLoading(false);
      }
    }

    function openProductHistory(key){
      const row = state.productResultsMap.get(key);
      if(!row) return;
      const {category, sub} = getProductScope();
      const scopeText = sub ? `${category} / ${sub}` : `${category} / ทั้งหมดในหมวด`;
      const lines = row.lines.map((x, idx) => `
        <tr>
          <td>${idx+1}</td>
          <td>${formatDate(x.date || '')}</td>
          <td>${esc(x.label)}</td>
          <td>${Math.round(x.qty).toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${Math.round(x.revenue).toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${esc(x.note || '-')}</td>
        </tr>
      `).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="6" class="sub-muted">ไม่มีประวัติ</td></tr>`;

      document.getElementById('modal-content').innerHTML = `
        <h3 style="font-size:16px;margin:0 0 8px;color:#064e3b;font-weight:900;">📦 ประวัติสินค้า: ${esc(row.v.name || '-')}</h3>
        <div style="font-size:12px;">🆔 OPD: <b>${esc(row.v.opd || '-')}</b></div>
        <div style="font-size:12px;">📞 เบอร์: ${esc(row.v.phone || '-')}</div>
        <div style="font-size:12px;">🔎 เงื่อนไข: <b>${esc(scopeText)}</b></div>
        <div style="font-size:12px;">📅 ล่าสุดที่ทำ: <b>${row.latestDate ? formatDate(row.latestDate) : '-'}</b> ${row.daysSinceProduct == null ? '' : `(ห่าง ${row.daysSinceProduct.toLocaleString()} วัน)`}</div>
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:#0a645a;font-weight:900;margin-top:6px;">จำนวนรวม ${Math.round(row.qtyTotal).toLocaleString()} • ยอดประเมิน ${Math.round(row.revenueTotal).toLocaleString()} บาท</div>
        <hr style="margin:14px 0;border:0;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;">
        <div class="table-wrap" style="padding:0;max-height:56vh;overflow:auto;">
          <table style="min-width:620px;">
            <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>วันที่</th><th>รายการ</th><th>จำนวน</th><th>ยอดประเมิน</th><th>หมายเหตุ</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>${lines}</tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      `;
      document.getElementById('customer-modal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function initProductInsight(){
      populateProductInsightSelectors();
      document.getElementById('productCategorySelect')?.addEventListener('change', () => {
        updateProductSubOptions();
        renderProductInsight();
      });
      document.getElementById('productSubSelect')?.addEventListener('change', renderProductInsight);
      document.getElementById('productSearchInput')?.addEventListener('input', () => {
        clearTimeout(state.productSearchTimer);
        state.productSearchTimer = setTimeout(renderProductInsight, 180);
      });
      document.getElementById('btnRunProductInsight')?.addEventListener('click', renderProductInsight);
      document.querySelectorAll('#productCustomersTable thead th[data-product-sort]').forEach(th => {
        th.addEventListener('click', () => setProductSort(th.dataset.productSort));
      });
      document.getElementById('btnSaveLegacyProduct')?.addEventListener('click', saveLegacyProductFromInsight);
    }


    function defaultUnitForCategory(category){
      const c = String(category || '');
      if(c.includes('ฟิลเลอร์')) return 'ชิ้น/cc';
      if(c.includes('โบทอค')) return 'ขวด/จุด';
      if(c.includes('ดริป') || c.includes('ทรีทเม้นท์') || c.includes('งานผิว')) return 'ครั้ง';
      return 'ชิ้น';
    }

    function buildDefaultEstimatedPriceRows(){
      const rows = [];
      let order = 10;
      Object.entries(productCategories).forEach(([category, subs]) => {
        (subs || []).forEach(name => {
          rows.push({
            id: '',
            category,
            product_name: name,
            unit_label: defaultUnitForCategory(category),
            estimated_price: 0,
            is_active: true,
            sort_order: order++
          });
        });
      });
      return rows;
    }

    function rebuildProductPriceMap(){
      state.productPriceMap = new Map();
      (state.productEstimatedPrices || []).forEach(r => {
        if(!r) return;
        state.productPriceMap.set(productPriceKey(r.category, r.product_name), r);
      });
    }

    async function loadProductEstimatedPrices(){
      try{
        const [catsRes, prodsRes] = await Promise.all([
          fetch('/api/categories'),
          fetch('/api/products')
        ]);
        if(!catsRes.ok || !prodsRes.ok) throw new Error('product_catalog_api_not_ready');

        const cats = await catsRes.json();
        const prods = await prodsRes.json();
        const categoriesArr = Array.isArray(cats) ? cats : [];
        const productsArr = Array.isArray(prods) ? prods : [];

        const catById = new Map(categoriesArr.map(c => [String(c.id), c]));
        const activeProducts = productsArr
          // Product Insight ใช้ทั้งสินค้าเปิดขายและสินค้าเก่า/ปิดใช้งาน
          // เพราะสินค้าเก่าอาจอยู่ในประวัติ แต่ไม่ควรขึ้นในหน้าบันทึกยอดขาย
          .filter(p => !p.deleted_at)
          .sort((a,b) => {
            const ca = catById.get(String(a.category_id)) || {};
            const cb = catById.get(String(b.category_id)) || {};
            return (Number(ca.sort_order || 0) - Number(cb.sort_order || 0)) ||
              String(ca.name || '').localeCompare(String(cb.name || ''), 'th') ||
              (Number(a.sort_order || 0) - Number(b.sort_order || 0)) ||
              String(a.name || '').localeCompare(String(b.name || ''), 'th');
          });

        const categoryMap = {};
        const priceRows = [];
        activeProducts.forEach(p => {
          const cat = catById.get(String(p.category_id)) || {};
          const category = String(cat.name || p.category_name || '').trim();
          const name = String(p.name || '').trim();
          if(!category || !name) return;
          if(!categoryMap[category]) categoryMap[category] = [];
          if(!categoryMap[category].includes(name)) categoryMap[category].push(name);
          priceRows.push({
            id: p.id,
            product_id: p.id,
            category,
            product_name: name,
            unit_label: p.estimated_unit || defaultUnitForCategory(category),
            estimated_price: Number(p.estimated_price || 0) || 0,
            is_active: p.is_active !== false,
            sort_order: Number(p.sort_order || 0)
          });
        });

        if(Object.keys(categoryMap).length){
          productCategories = categoryMap;
          state.productEstimatedPrices = priceRows;
        }else{
          state.productEstimatedPrices = buildDefaultEstimatedPriceRows();
        }
      }catch(e){
        console.warn('load product catalog from settings failed:', e);
        state.productEstimatedPrices = buildDefaultEstimatedPriceRows();
      }
      rebuildProductPriceMap();
      populateProductInsightSelectors();
      renderProductPriceSettings();
    }

    function renderPriceCategoryFilter(){
      const sel = document.getElementById('priceCategoryFilter');
      if(!sel) return;
      const current = sel.value || 'all';
      const cats = Object.keys(productCategories);
      sel.innerHTML = '<option value="all">ทุกหมวด</option>' + cats.map(c=>`<option value="${esc(c)}">${esc(c)}</option>`).join('');
      sel.value = cats.includes(current) ? current : 'all';
    }

    function filteredPriceRows(){
      const cat = document.getElementById('priceCategoryFilter')?.value || 'all';
      const q = String(document.getElementById('priceSearchInput')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      return (state.productEstimatedPrices || []).filter(r => {
        if(cat !== 'all' && r.category !== cat) return false;
        if(q){
          const hay = `${r.category||''} ${r.product_name||''} ${r.unit_label||''}`.toLowerCase();
          if(!hay.includes(q)) return false;
        }
        return true;
      });
    }

    function renderProductPriceSettings(){
      renderPriceCategoryFilter();
      const tb = document.querySelector('#priceTable tbody');
      const status = document.getElementById('priceStatus');
      if(!tb) return;
      const rows = filteredPriceRows();
      if(status) status.textContent = `แสดง ${rows.length.toLocaleString()} รายการ จากทั้งหมด ${(state.productEstimatedPrices||[]).length.toLocaleString()} รายการ`;
      tb.innerHTML = rows.map((r, idx) => {
        const rowKey = productPriceKey(r.category, r.product_name);
        return `<tr data-price-key="${esc(rowKey)}">
          <td>${esc(r.category || '-')}</td>
          <td style="font-weight:900;color:#064e3b;">${esc(r.product_name || '-')}</td>
          <td><input type="text" data-price-field="unit_label" value="${esc(r.unit_label || defaultUnitForCategory(r.category))}"></td>
          <td><input type="number" min="0" step="1" inputmode="numeric" data-price-field="estimated_price" value="${Number(r.estimated_price || 0)}"></td>
          <td>
            <select class="ipt" data-price-field="is_active">
              <option value="true" ${r.is_active !== false ? 'selected' : ''}>ใช้</option>
              <option value="false" ${r.is_active === false ? 'selected' : ''}>ปิด</option>
            </select>
          </td>
          <td><button class="icon-btn" type="button" onclick="saveEstimatedPriceByKey('${esc(rowKey)}')">บันทึก</button></td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="6" class="product-empty">ไม่พบรายการ</td></tr>`;
    }

    function collectEstimatedPriceRowByKey(rowKey){
      const row = (state.productEstimatedPrices || []).find(r => productPriceKey(r.category, r.product_name) === rowKey);
      const tr = [...document.querySelectorAll('#priceTable tbody tr[data-price-key]')].find(el => el.dataset.priceKey === rowKey);
      if(!row || !tr) return null;
      const unit = tr.querySelector('[data-price-field="unit_label"]')?.value || defaultUnitForCategory(row.category);
      const price = Number(tr.querySelector('[data-price-field="estimated_price"]')?.value || 0);
      const activeValue = tr.querySelector('[data-price-field="is_active"]')?.value;
      return {
        id: row.id || undefined,
        category: row.category,
        product_name: row.product_name,
        unit_label: unit.trim() || defaultUnitForCategory(row.category),
        estimated_price: Number.isFinite(price) && price > 0 ? price : 0,
        is_active: activeValue !== 'false',
        sort_order: Number(row.sort_order || 0)
      };
    }

    async function saveEstimatedPriceRow(payload){
      if(!payload?.id) throw new Error('missing_product_id');
      const res = await fetch('/api/products', {
        method:'PUT',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({
          id: payload.id,
          estimated_price: Number(payload.estimated_price || 0),
          estimated_unit: payload.unit_label || 'ชิ้น'
        })
      });
      const data = await res.json().catch(()=>({}));
      if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'save_failed');
      return {
        ...payload,
        ...(data.row || {}),
        unit_label: (data.row?.estimated_unit || payload.unit_label || 'ชิ้น'),
        estimated_price: Number(data.row?.estimated_price ?? payload.estimated_price ?? 0)
      };
    }

    async function saveEstimatedPriceByKey(rowKey){
      try{
        const payload = collectEstimatedPriceRowByKey(rowKey);
        if(!payload) return toast('ไม่พบแถวราคานี้', 'err');
        const saved = await saveEstimatedPriceRow(payload);
        const idx = state.productEstimatedPrices.findIndex(r => productPriceKey(r.category, r.product_name) === rowKey);
        if(idx >= 0) state.productEstimatedPrices[idx] = {...state.productEstimatedPrices[idx], ...saved, ...payload};
        rebuildProductPriceMap();
        renderProductInsight();
        toast('บันทึกราคาประเมินแล้ว', 'ok');
      }catch(e){
        toast('บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ: ' + (e.message || e), 'err');
      }
    }

    async function saveAllEstimatedPrices(){
      try{
        const visibleKeys = filteredPriceRows().map(r => productPriceKey(r.category, r.product_name));
        const rows = visibleKeys.map(collectEstimatedPriceRowByKey).filter(Boolean);
        if(!rows.length) return toast('ไม่มีรายการให้บันทึก', 'warn');
        const failures = [];
        await runWithConcurrency(rows, async (row)=>{
          try{
            await saveEstimatedPriceRow(row);
          }catch(err){
            failures.push({row, err});
          }
        }, 6);
        if(failures.length){
          throw new Error(`บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ ${failures.length} รายการ`);
        }
        await loadProductEstimatedPrices();
        renderProductInsight();
        toast(`บันทึกแล้ว ${rows.length.toLocaleString()} รายการ`, 'ok');
      }catch(e){
        toast('บันทึกทั้งหมดไม่สำเร็จ: ' + (e.message || e), 'err');
      }
    }

    function initProductPriceSettings(){
      renderProductPriceSettings();
      document.getElementById('priceCategoryFilter')?.addEventListener('change', renderProductPriceSettings);
      document.getElementById('priceSearchInput')?.addEventListener('input', () => {
        clearTimeout(state.productPriceTimer);
        state.productPriceTimer = setTimeout(renderProductPriceSettings, 160);
      });
      document.getElementById('btnReloadEstimatedPrices')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        await loadProductEstimatedPrices();
        toast('รีโหลดราคาประเมินแล้ว', 'ok');
      });
      document.getElementById('btnSaveAllEstimatedPrices')?.addEventListener('click', saveAllEstimatedPrices);
    }

    const today = () => new Date();
    const daysSince = (iso) => {
      if(!iso) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
      const d = new Date(iso);
      const t = today();
      return Math.floor((t - d)/(1000*60*60*24));
    };

    function iso10(v){
      const s = String(v || '').trim();
      return s ? s.slice(0,10) : '';
    }
    function daysBetweenISO(aISO, bISO){
      const a = iso10(aISO), b = iso10(bISO);
      if(!a || !b) return null;
      const [ay,am,ad] = a.split('-').map(Number);
      const [by,bm,bd] = b.split('-').map(Number);
      if(!ay || !am || !ad || !by || !bm || !bd) return null;
      return Math.floor((Date.UTC(by,bm-1,bd) - Date.UTC(ay,am-1,ad)) / 86400000);
    }
    function isInterestedOutcome(outcome){
      return /^สนใจ/.test(String(outcome || '').trim());
    }
    function isHardRejectOutcome(outcome){
      const s = String(outcome || '').trim();
      return s.includes('เบอร์ผิด') || s.includes('ไม่น่าจะกลับมา') || /^ไม่สนใจ/.test(s);
    }
    function isNoContactOutcome(outcome){
      const s = String(outcome || '').trim();
      return s.includes('ไม่รับสาย') || s.includes('ปิดเครื่อง') || s.includes('โทรไม่ติด');
    }
    function saleDateForRecord(r){
      return iso10(r?.date || r?.created_at || '');
    }
    function pitchDateForRecord(p){
      return iso10(p?.created_at || p?.date || '');
    }
    function allSalesForCustomer(v){
      const opd = pad4(v?.opd || '');
      const phone = normPhone(v?.phone || '');
      const name = String(v?.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const rows = state.allSales.filter(r => {
        const ropd = pad4(r.opd || '');
        if(opd && /^\d{4}$/.test(opd) && opd !== '0000' && ropd === opd) return true;
        const rphone = normPhone(r.phone || '');
        if(phone && rphone && rphone === phone) return true;
        const rname = String(r.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        return !!name && !!rname && rname === name;
      });
      rows.sort((a,b)=> String(saleDateForRecord(b)).localeCompare(String(saleDateForRecord(a))));
      return rows;
    }
    function countNoContactStreak(pitches){
      let n = 0;
      for(const p of pitches || []){
        if(isNoContactOutcome(p.outcome)) n++;
        else break;
      }
      return n;
    }
    function postInterestFollowupsWithoutVisit(pitches, lastSaleDate){
      const rows = (pitches || []).slice().sort((a,b)=> String(pitchDateForRecord(a)).localeCompare(String(pitchDateForRecord(b))));
      let latestInterestDate = '';
      rows.forEach(p => {
        const d = pitchDateForRecord(p);
        if(isInterestedOutcome(p.outcome) && d) latestInterestDate = d;
      });
      if(!latestInterestDate) return { hasInterest:false, count:0 };
      if(lastSaleDate && lastSaleDate > latestInterestDate) return { hasInterest:true, count:0, converted:true };
      const followups = rows.filter(p => {
        const d = pitchDateForRecord(p);
        return d && d > latestInterestDate;
      });
      return { hasInterest:true, count:followups.length, converted:false };
    }
    function contactBadgeHTML(info){
      const status = String(info.status || 'ควรโทร');
      let cls = 'b-gray';
      if(status === 'ควรโทร') cls = 'b-ok';
      else if(status === 'รอติดต่อภายหลัง') cls = 'b-gray';
      else if(status === 'พักติดต่อ') cls = 'b-warn';
      else if(status === 'หยุดติดต่อ') cls = 'b-bad';
      return `<span class="badge ${cls}">${esc(status)}</span>`;
    }
    function computeContactReasonForCustomer(v){
      const opd = pad4(v?.opd || '');
      const pitches = (state.pitchFullCache.get(opd) || []).slice()
        .sort((a,b)=> String(pitchDateForRecord(b)).localeCompare(String(pitchDateForRecord(a))));
      const sales = allSalesForCustomer(v);
      const lastSaleDate = sales[0] ? saleDateForRecord(sales[0]) : (v?.last ? iso10(v.last) : '');
      const latestPitch = pitches[0] || null;
      const lastPitchDate = latestPitch ? pitchDateForRecord(latestPitch) : '';
      const lastOutcome = latestPitch?.outcome || '';
      const todayStr = ymdLocal(new Date());
      const daysFromSale = lastSaleDate ? daysBetweenISO(lastSaleDate, todayStr) : null;
      const daysFromPitch = lastPitchDate ? daysBetweenISO(lastPitchDate, todayStr) : null;
      const noContactStreak = countNoContactStreak(pitches);
      const postInterest = postInterestFollowupsWithoutVisit(pitches, lastSaleDate);
      const isVIP = Number(v?.revenue || 0) >= 150000;

      let status = 'ควรโทร';
      let reason = '';

      if(lastSaleDate && daysFromSale !== null && daysFromSale >= 540){
        status = 'หยุดติดต่อ';
        reason = `ไม่มา ${daysFromSale.toLocaleString()} วัน (เกือบ 1 ปีครึ่ง+)`;
      }else if(isHardRejectOutcome(lastOutcome)){
        status = 'หยุดติดต่อ';
        reason = lastOutcome.includes('เบอร์ผิด') ? 'เบอร์ผิด' : 'ปฏิเสธชัดเจนล่าสุด';
      }else if(lastPitchDate && lastPitchDate === todayStr){
        status = 'รอติดต่อภายหลัง';
        reason = 'โทรวันนี้แล้ว ไม่ควรโทรซ้ำ';
      }else if(lastSaleDate && lastPitchDate && lastSaleDate > lastPitchDate){
        const waitText = (daysFromSale !== null && daysFromSale < 180)
          ? `มาแล้วหลังโทรล่าสุด พักโทรจนกว่าจะครบ 6 เดือน (มาแล้ว ${daysFromSale.toLocaleString()} วัน)`
          : `มาแล้วหลังโทรล่าสุด ${daysFromSale !== null ? daysFromSale.toLocaleString() + ' วัน' : ''}`;
        status = daysFromSale !== null && daysFromSale < 180 ? 'พักติดต่อ' : 'รอติดต่อภายหลัง';
        reason = waitText;
      }else if(lastSaleDate && daysFromSale !== null && daysFromSale < 120){
        status = 'รอติดต่อภายหลัง';
        reason = `เพิ่งมา ${daysFromSale.toLocaleString()} วัน ยังไม่ถึง 4 เดือน`;
      }else if(noContactStreak >= 3){
        status = 'พักติดต่อ';
        reason = `ติดต่อไม่ได้ ${noContactStreak} ครั้งติด`;
      }else if(postInterest.hasInterest && postInterest.count >= 2 && !postInterest.converted && !isNoContactOutcome(lastOutcome)){
        status = 'พักติดต่อ';
        reason = `เคยสนใจ แต่ตามอีก ${postInterest.count} ครั้งยังไม่มา`;
      }else if(isNoContactOutcome(lastOutcome)){
        status = 'รอติดต่อภายหลัง';
        reason = noContactStreak > 0
          ? `ล่าสุดติดต่อไม่ได้ ${noContactStreak} ครั้ง ยังพอโทรซ้ำได้`
          : 'ล่าสุดติดต่อไม่ได้';
      }else if(!pitches.length){
        status = 'ควรโทร';
        reason = lastSaleDate && daysFromSale !== null ? `ยังไม่เคยโทร / ไม่ได้มา ${daysFromSale.toLocaleString()} วัน` : 'ยังไม่เคยโทร';
      }else{
        status = 'ควรโทร';
        const base = lastSaleDate && daysFromSale !== null
          ? `ไม่ได้มา ${daysFromSale.toLocaleString()} วัน`
          : (daysFromPitch !== null ? `โทรล่าสุด ${daysFromPitch.toLocaleString()} วันก่อน` : 'ควรติดตาม');
        reason = isVIP ? `VIP + ${base}` : base;
      }

      if(!reason) reason = '-';
      return { status, reason, isVIP, lastSaleDate, lastPitchDate, lastOutcome };
    }


    const serviceGroupDefinitions = [
      {key:'botox', label:'โบท็อกซ์', terms:['โบท','botox','aestox','allergan','nabota']},
      {key:'filler', label:'ฟิลเลอร์', terms:['ฟิลเลอร์','filler','restylane','neuramis','e.p.t.q','eptq','ex-filler','res filler']},
      {key:'skin', label:'งานผิว/หน้าใส', terms:['งานผิว','หน้าใส','meso','p - cell','p-cell','aquatic','hestina','exosome','rejuran','sculptra','juvelook','aesthefill','prp','สะกิด','alphaarbutin','transamine','biocollagen']},
      {key:'hifu_fat', label:'ไขมัน/HIFU', terms:['fat','hifu','ไขมัน','เมโสแฟต','สลายไขมัน','bromi','sisi']},
      {key:'drip', label:'ดริปผิว/วิตามิน', terms:['ดริป','drip','vitamin','วิตามิน','snow white','aurawhite','brain booster','energy booster']},
      {key:'treatment', label:'ทรีทเมนท์/สิวฝ้า', terms:['ทรีท','treatment','กดสิว','subcision','ฝ้า','สิว','ผลักวิตามิน','ปั่น rf']},
      {key:'thread', label:'ร้อยไหม', terms:['ไหม','pdo','collagen','ลิฟท์']},
      {key:'weight', label:'ลดน้ำหนัก/ปากกา', terms:['ปากกา','ลดน้ำหนัก','mounj','ozempic','wegovy','saxenda']},
      {key:'other', label:'อื่น ๆ', terms:[]}
    ];
    const serviceGroupMap = new Map(serviceGroupDefinitions.map(x => [x.key, x]));
    const pitchCountBuckets = [
      {label:'0 ครั้ง', min:0, max:0},
      {label:'1–2 ครั้ง', min:1, max:2},
      {label:'3–5 ครั้ง', min:3, max:5},
      {label:'6–10 ครั้ง', min:6, max:10},
      {label:'11–20 ครั้ง', min:11, max:20},
      {label:'21+ ครั้ง', min:21, max:Infinity}
    ];
    const visitFrequencyBuckets = [
      {label:'มา 1 ครั้ง', min:1, max:1},
      {label:'มา 2 ครั้ง', min:2, max:2},
      {label:'มา 3–5 ครั้ง', min:3, max:5},
      {label:'มา 6–10 ครั้ง', min:6, max:10},
      {label:'มา 11+ ครั้ง', min:11, max:Infinity}
    ];
    const totalSpendBuckets = [
      {label:'0–4,999', min:0, max:4999},
      {label:'5,000–19,999', min:5000, max:19999},
      {label:'20,000–49,999', min:20000, max:49999},
      {label:'50,000–99,999', min:50000, max:99999},
      {label:'100,000+', min:100000, max:Infinity}
    ];

    function serviceGroupLabel(key){
      return serviceGroupMap.get(String(key || ''))?.label || 'อื่น ๆ';
    }
    function normalizeServiceText(s){
      return String(s || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    }
    function saleItemSearchText(item){
      const parsed = parseSaleItem(item);
      return normalizeServiceText([parsed.main, parsed.sub, parsed.label, parsed.display].join(' '));
    }
    function serviceGroupsForItem(item){
      const text = saleItemSearchText(item);
      const groups = new Set();
      if(!text) return groups;
      for(const def of serviceGroupDefinitions){
        if(def.key === 'other') continue;
        if(def.terms.some(t => text.includes(normalizeServiceText(t)))) groups.add(def.key);
      }
      return groups;
    }
    function customerServiceGroups(v){
      const groups = new Set();
      let sawItem = false;
      (v?.bills || []).forEach(b => {
        normalizeItemsArray(b.items).forEach(item => {
          sawItem = true;
          serviceGroupsForItem(item).forEach(g => groups.add(g));
        });
      });
      if(!groups.size && sawItem) groups.add('other');
      return groups;
    }
    function summarizeRows(rows){
      const arr = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
      const customers = arr.length;
      const visits = arr.reduce((s,v)=>s + (v.bills?.length || 0), 0);
      const revenue = Math.round(arr.reduce((s,v)=>s + (Number(v.revenue)||0), 0));
      const aov = visits ? Math.round(revenue / visits) : 0;
      return {customers, visits, revenue, aov};
    }


    function productKeyForParsedItem(parsed){
      const category = String(parsed?.main || '').trim() || 'ไม่ระบุหมวด';
      const productName = String(productItemDisplayName(parsed) || '').trim() || category;
      return productPriceKey(category, productName);
    }

    function productRowsForCustomer(v){
      const rows = [];
      (v?.bills || []).forEach((b, billIndex) => {
        normalizeItemsArray(b.items).map(parseSaleItem).forEach(parsed => {
          const category = String(parsed.main || '').trim() || 'ไม่ระบุหมวด';
          const productName = String(productItemDisplayName(parsed) || '').trim() || category;
          const key = productPriceKey(category, productName);
          rows.push({key, category, productName, parsed, billKey:`${v.key}|${String(b.date||'')}|${billIndex}`});
        });
      });
      return rows;
    }

    function customerMatchesProductKeys(v, keys = []){
      const need = new Set((Array.isArray(keys) ? keys : []).map(x => String(x || '')).filter(Boolean));
      if(!need.size) return true;
      for(const row of productRowsForCustomer(v)){
        if(need.has(row.key)) return true;
      }
      return false;
    }

    function buildDashboardProductRows(){
      const map = new Map();
      const customers = [...currentCustomers().values()];
      customers.forEach(v => {
        productRowsForCustomer(v).forEach(row => {
          const ag = map.get(row.key) || {
            key: row.key,
            category: row.category,
            productName: row.productName,
            customers: new Set(),
            billKeys: new Set(),
            qty: 0
          };
          ag.customers.add(v.key);
          if(row.billKey) ag.billKeys.add(row.billKey);
          ag.qty += Number(row.parsed?.qty || 1) || 1;
          map.set(row.key, ag);
        });
      });
      return [...map.values()].map(r => ({
        ...r,
        customerCount: r.customers.size,
        billCount: r.billKeys.size
      })).sort((a,b)=> (b.customerCount-a.customerCount) || (b.billCount-a.billCount) || String(a.productName).localeCompare(String(b.productName),'th'));
    }

    function dashboardProductRowText(row){
      if(!row) return '';
      const cat = String(row.category || '').trim();
      const name = String(row.productName || '').trim();
      if(cat && name && normalizeProductCompare(cat) !== normalizeProductCompare(name)) return `${cat} / ${name}`;
      return name || cat || '-';
    }

    function productItemLayerLabel(layer){
      const keys = Array.isArray(layer?.keys) ? layer.keys : (layer?.key ? [layer.key] : []);
      const labels = keys.map(k => dashboardProductRowText(state.dashboardProductRowMap?.get(k)) || String(k || '')).filter(Boolean);
      if(labels.length === 1) return `สินค้า: ${labels[0]}`;
      if(labels.length > 1) return `สินค้า ${labels.length} รายการ`;
      return 'สินค้า';
    }

    function buildProductTabProductRows(){
      const cat = document.getElementById('productCategorySelect')?.value || '';
      const rows = buildDashboardProductRows();
      return cat ? rows.filter(r => normalizeProductCompare(r.category) === normalizeProductCompare(cat)) : rows;
    }

    function getProductPickerSelectedSet(source){
      if(source === 'productTab'){
        if(!(state.productTabSelectedProductKeys instanceof Set)) state.productTabSelectedProductKeys = new Set();
        return state.productTabSelectedProductKeys;
      }
      if(!(state.dashboardSelectedProductKeys instanceof Set)) state.dashboardSelectedProductKeys = new Set();
      return state.dashboardSelectedProductKeys;
    }

    function setProductPickerSelectedSet(source, set){
      if(source === 'productTab') state.productTabSelectedProductKeys = set;
      else state.dashboardSelectedProductKeys = set;
    }

    function getProductPickerRows(source){
      const rows = source === 'productTab' ? buildProductTabProductRows() : buildDashboardProductRows();
      if(source === 'productTab'){
        state.productTabProductRows = rows;
        state.productTabProductRowMap = new Map(rows.map(r => [r.key, r]));
      }else{
        state.dashboardProductRows = rows;
        state.dashboardProductRowMap = new Map(rows.map(r => [r.key, r]));
      }
      return rows;
    }

    function productPickerCategoryStats(rows){
      const map = new Map();
      rows.forEach(r => {
        const cat = String(r.category || 'ไม่ระบุหมวด').trim() || 'ไม่ระบุหมวด';
        const ag = map.get(cat) || {category:cat, productCount:0, customerSet:new Set(), billCount:0, qty:0};
        ag.productCount += 1;
        (r.customers || new Set()).forEach(k => ag.customerSet.add(k));
        ag.billCount += Number(r.billCount || 0);
        ag.qty += Number(r.qty || 0);
        map.set(cat, ag);
      });
      return [...map.values()].map(x => ({...x, customerCount:x.customerSet.size})).sort((a,b)=> (b.customerCount-a.customerCount) || String(a.category).localeCompare(String(b.category),'th'));
    }

    function renderDashboardProductPicker(){
      const countEl = document.getElementById('dashboardProductSelectedCount');
      const selected = getProductPickerSelectedSet('dashboard');
      if(countEl) countEl.textContent = selected.size ? `เลือก ${selected.size.toLocaleString()} รายการ` : 'เลือกจากหมวด';
    }

    function renderProductTabProductPicker(){
      const countEl = document.getElementById('productTabProductSelectedCount');
      const selected = getProductPickerSelectedSet('productTab');
      const cat = document.getElementById('productCategorySelect')?.value || '';
      if(countEl) countEl.textContent = selected.size ? `เลือก ${selected.size.toLocaleString()} รายการ` : (cat ? `เลือกใน ${cat}` : 'เลือกจากหมวด');
    }

    function openProductPickerPopup(source = 'dashboard', event){
      if(event) event.stopPropagation();
      state.productPickerPopupOpen = true;
      state.productPickerPopupSource = source === 'productTab' ? 'productTab' : 'dashboard';
      state.productPickerPopupSearch = '';

      const rows = getProductPickerRows(state.productPickerPopupSource);
      const cats = productPickerCategoryStats(rows);
      const selectedCatFromTab = state.productPickerPopupSource === 'productTab' ? (document.getElementById('productCategorySelect')?.value || '') : '';
      const catExists = c => cats.some(x => normalizeProductCompare(x.category) === normalizeProductCompare(c));
      if(selectedCatFromTab && catExists(selectedCatFromTab)) state.productPickerPopupCategory = selectedCatFromTab;
      else if(!state.productPickerPopupCategory || !catExists(state.productPickerPopupCategory)) state.productPickerPopupCategory = cats[0]?.category || '';

      const modal = document.getElementById('productPickerPopup');
      if(modal) modal.classList.add('show');
      const search = document.getElementById('productPickerPopupSearch');
      if(search) search.value = '';
      renderProductPickerPopup();
      setTimeout(()=>{ try{ search?.focus(); }catch(e){} }, 40);
    }

    function closeProductPickerPopup(event){
      if(event && event.target && event.target.id !== 'productPickerPopup') return;
      state.productPickerPopupOpen = false;
      const modal = document.getElementById('productPickerPopup');
      if(modal) modal.classList.remove('show');
      renderDashboardProductPicker();
      renderProductTabProductPicker();
    }

    function setProductPickerPopupSearch(value){
      state.productPickerPopupSearch = String(value || '');
      renderProductPickerPopup();
    }

    function selectProductPickerCategory(category){
      state.productPickerPopupCategory = String(category || '');
      renderProductPickerPopup();
    }

    function currentProductPickerVisibleRows(rows){
      const q = normalizeProductCompare(state.productPickerPopupSearch || '');
      const cat = String(state.productPickerPopupCategory || '');
      return rows.filter(r => {
        const text = normalizeProductCompare(`${r.category} ${r.productName}`);
        if(q) return text.includes(q);
        return normalizeProductCompare(r.category) === normalizeProductCompare(cat);
      });
    }

    function renderProductPickerPopup(){
      const modal = document.getElementById('productPickerPopup');
      if(!modal || !state.productPickerPopupOpen) return;
      const source = state.productPickerPopupSource === 'productTab' ? 'productTab' : 'dashboard';
      const rows = getProductPickerRows(source);
      const cats = productPickerCategoryStats(rows);
      const selected = getProductPickerSelectedSet(source);
      const q = normalizeProductCompare(state.productPickerPopupSearch || '');

      const title = document.getElementById('productPickerPopupTitle');
      const count = document.getElementById('productPickerPopupCount');
      const catList = document.getElementById('productPickerCategoryList');
      const productList = document.getElementById('productPickerProductList');
      const selectedText = document.getElementById('productPickerSelectedText');
      if(title) title.textContent = source === 'productTab' ? 'เลือกสินค้า/บริการเพื่อดูข้อมูล' : 'เลือกสินค้า/บริการเพื่อกรองลูกค้า';
      if(count) count.textContent = rows.length ? `${cats.length.toLocaleString()} หมวด · ${rows.length.toLocaleString()} สินค้า/บริการ` : 'ไม่พบสินค้า/บริการในผลลัพธ์ปัจจุบัน';
      if(selectedText) selectedText.textContent = selected.size ? `เลือกอยู่ ${selected.size.toLocaleString()} รายการ` : 'ยังไม่ได้เลือกสินค้า';

      if(catList){
        catList.innerHTML = cats.map(c => {
          const active = normalizeProductCompare(c.category) === normalizeProductCompare(state.productPickerPopupCategory) && !q ? 'active' : '';
          return `<button type="button" class="product-picker-cat ${active}" onclick='selectProductPickerCategory(${inlineStringLiteral(c.category)})' title="${esc(c.category)}">
            <b>${esc(c.category)}</b>
            <span>${c.productCount.toLocaleString()} รายการ · ${c.customerCount.toLocaleString()} ลูกค้า</span>
          </button>`;
        }).join('') || `<div class="product-picker-popup__empty">ไม่มีหมวดสินค้า</div>`;
      }

      const visibleRows = currentProductPickerVisibleRows(rows);
      if(productList){
        productList.innerHTML = visibleRows.map(r => {
          const checked = selected.has(r.key) ? 'checked' : '';
          const label = dashboardProductRowText(r);
          return `<label class="product-picker-row" title="${esc(label)}">
            <input type="checkbox" ${checked} onchange='toggleProductPickerCheck(${inlineStringLiteral(r.key)}, this.checked)'>
            <span class="product-picker-row__main">
              <b>${esc(r.productName || r.category || '-')}</b>
              <em>${esc(r.category || '-')} · ${r.customerCount.toLocaleString()} ราย · ${r.billCount.toLocaleString()} บิล · จำนวน ${Math.round(r.qty).toLocaleString()}</em>
            </span>
            <button type="button" class="icon-btn" title="กรอง ${esc(label)}" onclick='event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();applyProductPickerFilterByKey(${inlineStringLiteral(r.key)})'>👁</button>
          </label>`;
        }).join('') || `<div class="product-picker-popup__empty">${q ? 'ไม่พบสินค้าที่ค้นหา' : 'เลือกหมวดด้านซ้ายก่อน หรือหมวดนี้ยังไม่มีสินค้า'}</div>`;
      }
    }

    function toggleProductPickerCheck(key, checked){
      const source = state.productPickerPopupSource === 'productTab' ? 'productTab' : 'dashboard';
      const selected = getProductPickerSelectedSet(source);
      const k = String(key || '');
      if(!k) return;
      if(checked) selected.add(k);
      else selected.delete(k);
      setProductPickerSelectedSet(source, selected);
      renderProductPickerPopup();
      renderDashboardProductPicker();
      renderProductTabProductPicker();
    }

    function selectAllProductsInPickerCategory(){
      const source = state.productPickerPopupSource === 'productTab' ? 'productTab' : 'dashboard';
      const rows = getProductPickerRows(source);
      const selected = getProductPickerSelectedSet(source);
      currentProductPickerVisibleRows(rows).forEach(r => selected.add(r.key));
      setProductPickerSelectedSet(source, selected);
      renderProductPickerPopup();
      renderDashboardProductPicker();
      renderProductTabProductPicker();
    }

    function clearProductPickerChecks(){
      const source = state.productPickerPopupSource === 'productTab' ? 'productTab' : 'dashboard';
      setProductPickerSelectedSet(source, new Set());
      renderProductPickerPopup();
      renderDashboardProductPicker();
      renderProductTabProductPicker();
    }

    function productPickerRowByKey(key, source){
      const k = String(key || '');
      const map = source === 'productTab' ? state.productTabProductRowMap : state.dashboardProductRowMap;
      if(map?.has(k)) return map.get(k);
      const rows = getProductPickerRows(source);
      return rows.find(r => r.key === k) || null;
    }

    function applyProductPickerFilterByKey(key){
      const source = state.productPickerPopupSource === 'productTab' ? 'productTab' : 'dashboard';
      const k = String(key || '');
      if(!k) return toast('ไม่พบสินค้า/บริการที่จะกรอง', 'err');
      const row = productPickerRowByKey(k, source);
      const label = row ? `สินค้า: ${dashboardProductRowText(row)}` : 'สินค้า';
      closeProductPickerPopup();
      addFilterLayer({type:'productItem', keys:[k], label});
      if(source === 'productTab') setMainView('finance');
    }

    function applyProductPickerSelected(){
      const source = state.productPickerPopupSource === 'productTab' ? 'productTab' : 'dashboard';
      const keys = [...getProductPickerSelectedSet(source)].filter(Boolean);
      if(!keys.length) return toast('ติ๊กสินค้า/บริการก่อน', 'err');
      const names = keys.map(k => dashboardProductRowText(productPickerRowByKey(k, source))).filter(Boolean);
