      const label = names.length === 1 ? `สินค้า: ${names[0]}` : `สินค้า ${keys.length} รายการ`;
      closeProductPickerPopup();
      addFilterLayer({type:'productItem', keys, label});
      if(source === 'productTab') setMainView('finance');
    }

    // ชื่อเดิมเก็บไว้เป็น compatibility เผื่อมี onclick/flow เก่าเรียกอยู่
    function toggleDashboardProductDropdown(event){ openProductPickerPopup('dashboard', event); }
    function toggleProductTabProductDropdown(event){ openProductPickerPopup('productTab', event); }
    function setDashboardProductSearch(value){ state.productPickerPopupSearch = String(value || ''); renderProductPickerPopup(); }
    function setProductTabProductSearch(value){ state.productPickerPopupSearch = String(value || ''); renderProductPickerPopup(); }
    function toggleDashboardProductCheck(key, checked){ state.productPickerPopupSource = 'dashboard'; toggleProductPickerCheck(key, checked); }
    function toggleProductTabProductCheck(key, checked){ state.productPickerPopupSource = 'productTab'; toggleProductPickerCheck(key, checked); }
    function clearDashboardProductChecks(){ state.dashboardSelectedProductKeys = new Set(); renderDashboardProductPicker(); renderProductPickerPopup(); }
    function clearProductTabProductChecks(){ state.productTabSelectedProductKeys = new Set(); renderProductTabProductPicker(); renderProductPickerPopup(); }
    function applyProductItemFilterByKey(key){ state.productPickerPopupSource = 'dashboard'; applyProductPickerFilterByKey(key); }
    function applyProductTabProductFilterByKey(key){ state.productPickerPopupSource = 'productTab'; applyProductPickerFilterByKey(key); }
    function applyDashboardSelectedProducts(){ state.productPickerPopupSource = 'dashboard'; applyProductPickerSelected(); }
    function applyProductTabSelectedProducts(){ state.productPickerPopupSource = 'productTab'; applyProductPickerSelected(); }

    function renderServiceGroupStats(){
      const tbody = document.querySelector('#serviceGroupStatsTable tbody');
      if(!tbody) return;
      const cust = [...currentCustomers().values()];
      const totalN = cust.length || 1;
      const rows = serviceGroupDefinitions.map(def => {
        const matched = cust.filter(v => customerServiceGroups(v).has(def.key));
        const sum = summarizeRows(matched);
        return {def, matched, ...sum};
      }).filter(r => r.customers > 0 || r.def.key !== 'other');

      tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r=>{
        const pct = cust.length ? (r.customers * 100 / totalN).toFixed(1) + '%' : '-';
        return `<tr>
          <td><b>${esc(r.def.label)}</b></td>
          <td>${r.customers.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${pct}</td>
          <td>${r.visits.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${r.revenue.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td style="text-align:center"><button class="icon-btn" title="ดูรายชื่อ${esc(r.def.label)}" onclick="applyServiceGroupFilter('${esc(r.def.key)}')">👁</button></td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="6" class="sub-muted">ไม่มีข้อมูล</td></tr>`;
    }

    function renderPitchCountStats(){
      const tbody = document.querySelector('#pitchCountStatsTable tbody');
      if(!tbody) return;
      const cust = [...currentCustomers().values()];
      const totalN = cust.length || 1;
      const hasPitchLoaded = cust.some(v => state.pitchSummaryCache.has(pad4(v.opd || '')));
      tbody.innerHTML = pitchCountBuckets.map(b=>{
        const matched = cust.filter(v => {
          const count = getPitchCountForCustomer(v);
          return count >= b.min && count <= b.max;
        });
        const sum = summarizeRows(matched);
        const pitchTotal = matched.reduce((acc,v)=>acc + getPitchCountForCustomer(v), 0);
        const pct = cust.length ? (sum.customers * 100 / totalN).toFixed(1) + '%' : '-';
        return `<tr>
          <td><b>${esc(b.label)}</b></td>
          <td>${sum.customers.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${pct}</td>
          <td>${sum.revenue.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${pitchTotal.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td style="text-align:center"><button class="icon-btn" title="ดูรายชื่อลูกค้า Pitch ${esc(b.label)}" onclick='applyPitchCountFilter(${inlineNumberLiteral(b.min)}, ${inlineNumberLiteral(b.max)}, ${inlineStringLiteral(b.label)})'>👁</button></td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="6" class="sub-muted">ไม่มีข้อมูล</td></tr>`;
      const note = document.getElementById('pitchCountStatsNote');
      if(note){
        const missing = cust.filter(v => v.opd && !state.pitchSummaryCache.has(pad4(v.opd))).length;
        if(missing) note.textContent = `กำลังโหลดจำนวน Pitch อีก ${missing.toLocaleString()} ราย — ตัวเลขจะอัปเดตเอง`;
        else if(!hasPitchLoaded) note.textContent = 'ยังไม่มีข้อมูล Pitch ในผลลัพธ์ปัจจุบัน';
        else note.textContent = 'อิงจำนวนบันทึก Pitch ตาม OPD และล้อไปตามฟิลเตอร์ปัจจุบัน';
      }
    }

    function renderVisitFrequencyStats(){
      const tbody = document.querySelector('#visitFrequencyStatsTable tbody');
      if(!tbody) return;
      const cust = [...currentCustomers().values()];
      const totalN = cust.length || 1;
      tbody.innerHTML = visitFrequencyBuckets.map(b=>{
        const matched = cust.filter(v => {
          const visits = v.bills?.length || 0;
          return visits >= b.min && visits <= b.max;
        });
        const sum = summarizeRows(matched);
        const pct = cust.length ? (sum.customers * 100 / totalN).toFixed(1) + '%' : '-';
        return `<tr>
          <td><b>${esc(b.label)}</b></td>
          <td>${sum.customers.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${pct}</td>
          <td>${sum.revenue.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${sum.aov.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td style="text-align:center"><button class="icon-btn" title="ดูรายชื่อ${esc(b.label)}" onclick='applyVisitFrequency(${inlineNumberLiteral(b.min)}, ${inlineNumberLiteral(b.max)}, ${inlineStringLiteral(b.label)})'>👁</button></td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="6" class="sub-muted">ไม่มีข้อมูล</td></tr>`;
    }

    function renderTotalSpendStats(){
      const tbody = document.querySelector('#totalSpendStatsTable tbody');
      if(!tbody) return;
      const cust = [...currentCustomers().values()];
      const totalN = cust.length || 1;
      tbody.innerHTML = totalSpendBuckets.map(b=>{

        const sum = summarizeRows(matched);
        const pct = cust.length ? (sum.customers * 100 / totalN).toFixed(1) + '%' : '-';
        return `<tr>
          <td><b>${esc(b.label)}</b></td>
          <td>${sum.customers.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${pct}</td>
          <td>${sum.visits.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${sum.aov.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td style="text-align:center"><button class="icon-btn" title="ดูรายชื่อยอดสะสม ${esc(b.label)}" onclick='applyTotalSpend(${inlineNumberLiteral(b.min)}, ${inlineNumberLiteral(b.max)}, ${inlineStringLiteral(b.label)})'>👁</button></td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="6" class="sub-muted">ไม่มีข้อมูล</td></tr>`;
    }

    function normalizeCustomerNameColor(color){
      const c = String(color || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if(c === 'แดง') return 'red';
      if(c === 'ส้ม') return 'orange';
      if(c === 'เขียว') return 'green';
      if(c === 'ทอง' || c === 'vip' || c === 'golden') return 'gold';
      return ['red','orange','green','gold'].includes(c) ? c : 'green';
    }
    function nameColorText(color){
      const c = normalizeCustomerNameColor(color);
      if(c === 'gold') return 'ทอง VIP';
      if(c === 'red') return 'แดง';
      if(c === 'orange') return 'ส้ม';
      return 'เขียว';
    }
    function nameColorDotHtml(color){
      const c = normalizeCustomerNameColor(color);
      return `<span class="customer-name-dot ${c === 'green' ? '' : c}" aria-hidden="true"></span>`;
    }
    function getCustomerNameColor(vOrOpd){
      const opd = typeof vOrOpd === 'string' ? vOrOpd : (vOrOpd?.opd || '');
      const snap = customerSnapshotByOpd(opd);
      const fallback = (vOrOpd && typeof vOrOpd === 'object') ? vOrOpd.name_color : '';
      return normalizeCustomerNameColor(snap.name_color || fallback || 'green');
    }
    function customerNameLinkHtml(v, keyOverride = null){
      const key = keyOverride || modalKeyForCustomer(v);
      const color = getCustomerNameColor(v);
      return `<a class="link customer-name-link customer-name--${color} name-color-${color}" href="javascript:;" onclick="openCustomerModal('${esc(key)}');event.stopPropagation();">${nameColorDotHtml(color)}${esc(v?.name || '-')}</a>`;
    }
    function renderNameColorStats(){
      const tbody = document.querySelector('#nameColorStatsTable tbody');
      if(!tbody) return;
      const cust = [...currentCustomers().values()];
      const totalN = cust.length || 1;
      const configs = [
        {color:'gold', label:'ทอง VIP'},
        {color:'red', label:'แดง'},
        {color:'orange', label:'ส้ม'},
        {color:'green', label:'เขียว'}
      ];
      tbody.innerHTML = configs.map(cfg=>{
        const rows = cust.filter(v => getCustomerNameColor(v) === cfg.color);
        const rev = Math.round(rows.reduce((sum,v)=>sum + (Number(v.revenue)||0), 0));
        const pct = cust.length ? (rows.length * 100 / totalN).toFixed(1) + '%' : '-';
        return `<tr>
          <td>${nameColorDotHtml(cfg.color)}<b>${cfg.label}</b></td>
          <td>${rows.length.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${pct}</td>
          <td>${rev.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td style="text-align:center"><button class="icon-btn" title="ดูรายชื่อสี${esc(cfg.label)}" onclick="applyNameColorFilter('${cfg.color}')">👁</button></td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('');
    }
    function pitchOutcomeCategoryFromOutcome(outcome){
      const s = String(outcome || '').trim();
      if(!s) return '';
      if(/^สนใจ/.test(s)) return 'interested';
      if(s.includes('ไม่รับสาย') || s.includes('ไม่รับโทรศัพท์')) return 'no_answer';
      if(s.includes('ติดต่อไม่ได้') || s.includes('ปิดเครื่อง') || s.includes('โทรไม่ติด')) return 'unreachable';
      if(/^ไม่สนใจ/.test(s) || s.includes('ไม่น่าจะกลับมา') || s.includes('ปฏิเสธ')) return 'not_interested';
      return 'other';
    }
    function getPitchOutcomeCategoryForCustomer(v){
      const sum = state.pitchSummaryCache.get(pad4(v?.opd || '')) || {};
      return pitchOutcomeCategoryFromOutcome(sum.latest?.outcome || '');
    }
    function getPitchCountForCustomer(v){
      const sum = state.pitchSummaryCache.get(pad4(v?.opd || '')) || {};
      const n = Number(sum.count || 0);
      return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
    }
    function pitchOutcomeCategoryText(category){
      const c = String(category || '');
      if(c === 'interested') return 'สนใจ';
      if(c === 'not_interested') return 'ไม่สนใจ';
      if(c === 'no_answer') return 'ไม่รับโทรศัพท์';
      if(c === 'unreachable') return 'ติดต่อไม่ได้';
      if(c === 'other') return 'อื่น ๆ';
      return 'ยังไม่มีข้อมูล';
    }
    function renderPitchOutcomeStats(){
      const tbody = document.querySelector('#pitchOutcomeStatsTable tbody');
      if(!tbody) return;
      const cust = [...currentCustomers().values()];
      const totalN = cust.length || 1;
      const configs = [
        {category:'interested', label:'สนใจ'},
        {category:'not_interested', label:'ไม่สนใจ'},
        {category:'no_answer', label:'ไม่รับโทรศัพท์'},
        {category:'unreachable', label:'ติดต่อไม่ได้'}
      ];
      tbody.innerHTML = configs.map(cfg=>{
        const rows = cust.filter(v => getPitchOutcomeCategoryForCustomer(v) === cfg.category);
        const pitchTotal = rows.reduce((sum,v)=>sum + (Number((state.pitchSummaryCache.get(pad4(v.opd || '')) || {}).count)||0), 0);
        const pct = cust.length ? (rows.length * 100 / totalN).toFixed(1) + '%' : '-';
        return `<tr>
          <td><b>${esc(cfg.label)}</b></td>
          <td>${rows.length.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${pct}</td>
          <td>${pitchTotal.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td style="text-align:center"><button class="icon-btn" title="ดูรายชื่อผล Pitch: ${esc(cfg.label)}" onclick="applyPitchOutcomeFilter('${cfg.category}')">👁</button></td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="5" class="sub-muted">ไม่มีข้อมูล</td></tr>`;
      const note = document.getElementById('pitchOutcomeStatsNote');
      if(note){
        const missing = cust.filter(v => v.opd && !state.pitchSummaryCache.has(pad4(v.opd))).length;
        const unmatched = cust.filter(v => {
          const cat = getPitchOutcomeCategoryForCustomer(v);
          return !['interested','not_interested','no_answer','unreachable'].includes(cat);
        }).length;
        if(missing) note.textContent = `กำลังโหลดสรุป Pitch อีก ${missing.toLocaleString()} ราย — ตัวเลขจะอัปเดตเอง`;
        else note.textContent = `อิงผล Pitch ล่าสุดตาม OPD • รายที่ยังไม่มี/ผลอื่น ๆ ${unmatched.toLocaleString()} ราย`;
      }
    }

    function buildFinalRows(){
      const m=currentCustomers();
      state.finalRows = [...m.values()].map(v=>{
        const visits=v.bills.length, total=v.revenue, avg=visits? Math.round(total/visits):0;

        let recColor='#6b7280';
        if(v.recency<30) recColor='green';
        else if(v.recency<=90) recColor='orange';
        else recColor='crimson';

        let totColor='#6b7280', totExtra='', totIcon='';
        if(total<50000) totColor='crimson';
        else if(total<=99999) totColor='green';
        else if(total<=200000) totColor='goldenrod';
        else { totColor='#8B6508'; totExtra='font-weight:bold;'; totIcon=' 💎'; }

        let avgColor='#6b7280';
        if(avg<3000) avgColor='crimson';
        else if(avg<=9999) avgColor='green';
        else avgColor=varGold();

        const sum = state.pitchSummaryCache.get(v.opd) || { latest:null, count:0 };
        const latest = sum.latest;
        const pitchCount = sum.count || 0;

        const days = latest ? daysSince(latest.created_at) : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        const outcomeStr = latest ? `${latest.content||'-'}${latest.outcome? ' — '+latest.outcome : ''}` : '';

        return {
          v, visits, avg, total, maxBill:Math.round(v.maxBill||0),
          recency:v.recency, recColor, totColor, totExtra, totIcon, avgColor,
          rfm: state.rfmByKey.get(v.key) || '-', abc: state.abcByKey.get(v.key) || '-',
          lastPitchDays: isFinite(days)? days : null,
          lastOutcomeStr: outcomeStr,
          pitchCount,
          contactInfo: computeContactReasonForCustomer(v),
          profile: state.profileByOpd.get(v.opd) || ''
        };
      });
    }

    function renderFinalTable(){
      const col = state.finalSort.col, dir = state.finalSort.dir;
      const val = (r,idx) => {
        switch(idx){
          case 1: return r.v.opd||'';
          case 2: return (r.v.name||'').toLowerCase();
          case 3: return r.visits||0;
          case 4: return r.total||0;
          case 5: return r.avg||0;
          case 6: return r.recency||0;
          case 7: return `${r.rfm||''} ${r.abc||''}`.toLowerCase();
          case 8: return (r.lastPitchDays!=null? r.lastPitchDays : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
          case 9: return `${r.contactInfo?.status || ''} ${r.contactInfo?.reason || ''}`.toLowerCase();
          default: return 0;
        }
      };

      state.finalRows.sort((a,b)=>{
        const A=val(a,col), B=val(b,col);
        let cmp = 0;
        if(typeof A==='number' && typeof B==='number') cmp = (A-B);
        else cmp = (A>B?1:A<B?-1:0);

        if(cmp===0){
          const ao = (a.v.opd||''); const bo = (b.v.opd||'');
          if(ao!==bo) return (ao>bo?1:-1);
          const an = (a.v.name||'').toLowerCase(); const bn = (b.v.name||'').toLowerCase();
          if(an!==bn) return (an>bn?1:-1);
          return 0;
        }
        return cmp*dir;
      });

      const tb = document.querySelector('#finalCustTable tbody');
      tb.innerHTML = state.finalRows.map((r,i)=>{
        const key = modalKeyForCustomer(r.v);

        const pitchText = (r.lastPitchDays==null) ? 'ไม่เคย' : `${r.lastPitchDays} วัน`;
        const latest = (state.pitchSummaryCache.get(r.v.opd)||{}).latest;
        const dd = latest ? String(latest.created_at||'').slice(0,10) : '';
        const pitchTitle = latest
          ? `Pitch ล่าสุด: ${formatDate(dd)} • ${latest.content||''}${latest.outcome? ' — '+latest.outcome : ''} • รวม ${r.pitchCount||0} ครั้ง`
          : `— • รวม ${r.pitchCount||0} ครั้ง`;

        const rfmBadge = (() => {
          const s = String(r.rfm||'');
          if(s.includes('แชมป์')) return `<span class="badge b-ok">🏆 ${esc(s)}</span>`;
          if(s.includes('ประจำ')) return `<span class="badge b-ok">💚 ${esc(s)}</span>`;
          if(s.includes('เสี่ยง')) return `<span class="badge b-warn">⚠️ ${esc(s)}</span>`;
          if(s.includes('ไม่มี')) return `<span class="badge b-gray">🪵 ${esc(s)}</span>`;
          return `<span class="badge b-gray">${esc(s||'-')}</span>`;
        })();
        const abcBadge = (() => {
          const s = String(r.abc||'-').toUpperCase();
          if(s==='A') return `<span class="badge b-ok">A</span>`;
          if(s==='B') return `<span class="badge b-warn">B</span>`;
          if(s==='C') return `<span class="badge b-gray">C</span>`;
          return `<span class="badge b-gray">-</span>`;
        })();

        return `<tr data-opd="${esc(r.v.opd)}">
          <td>${i+1}</td>
          <td>${esc(r.v.opd)}</td>
          <td>${customerNameLinkHtml(r.v, key)}</td>
          <td>${r.visits}</td>
          <td style="color:${r.totColor}; ${r.totExtra}">${Math.round(r.total).toLocaleString()}${r.totIcon}</td>
          <td style="color:${r.avgColor}">${r.avg.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td style="color:${r.recColor}">${r.recency}</td>
          <td>${rfmBadge}<div style="margin-top:4px">${abcBadge}</div></td>
          <td class="lp-cell" title="${esc(pitchTitle)}">${esc(pitchText)}</td>
          <td title="${esc((r.contactInfo?.status || '') + ' — ' + (r.contactInfo?.reason || ''))}">
            ${contactBadgeHTML(r.contactInfo || {})}
            <div class="sub-muted" style="margin-top:4px;line-height:1.35">${esc(r.contactInfo?.reason || '-')}</div>
          </td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="10" class="sub-muted">ไม่มีลูกค้าตามเงื่อนไข</td></tr>`;
    }

    /* KPI update (ใหม่ แค่แสดงผล ไม่แตะตรรกะฟิลเตอร์) */
    function updateKpis(){
      const cust = [...currentCustomers().values()];
      const nCust = cust.length;
      const rev = Math.round(cust.reduce((s,v)=> s+(v.revenue||0), 0));
      const bills = cust.reduce((s,v)=> s+(v.bills?.length||0), 0);
      const aov = bills ? Math.round(rev / bills) : 0;

      const risk = cust.filter(v => (v.recency||0) >= 90).length;

      // นับ A-class จาก abcByKey
      let aCount = 0;
      for(const v of cust){
        if(state.abcByKey.get(v.key) === 'A') aCount++;
      }

      const setTxt = (id, val) => { const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.textContent = val; };
      setTxt('kpiCustomersV', nCust.toLocaleString());
      setTxt('kpiRevenueV', rev.toLocaleString());
      setTxt('kpiAovV', aov.toLocaleString());
      setTxt('kpiRiskV', risk.toLocaleString());
      setTxt('kpiAClassV', aCount.toLocaleString());
    }

    async function hydratePitchSummaryForCurrentRows(){
      const token = ++state.lastHydrateToken;

      const opds = [...new Set([...currentCustomers().values()].map(v=>v.opd).filter(Boolean))];

      // ต้อง render ก่อนเสมอ แม้ผลลัพธ์เป็น 0 คน ไม่งั้นตารางจะค้างรายชื่อเก่าและดูเหมือนกรองไม่ทำงาน
      buildFinalRows();
      renderFinalTable();
      if(!opds.length) return;

      await fetchPitchSummaryBatch(opds);
      // ห้ามโหลด pitch แบบเต็มทุก OPD ตอนกดฟิลเตอร์ เพราะกลุ่มใหญ่ เช่น 365 ขึ้นไป จะยิง request จำนวนมากจนหน้าค้าง
      // ประวัติเต็มจะโหลดเฉพาะตอนกดเปิดประวัติ/โมดัลลูกค้ารายนั้นแทน
      if(token !== state.lastHydrateToken) return;

      buildFinalRows();
      renderFinalTable();
      renderPitchOutcomeStats();
      renderPitchCountStats();
    }

    function renderAll(){
      renderRFM();
      const abcRes = computeABC();
      renderRecencyDistribution();
      renderSpendBands();
      renderWeekdayRevenueStats();
      renderAgeRangeStats();
      renderNameColorStats();
      renderPitchOutcomeStats();
      renderServiceGroupStats();
      renderDashboardProductPicker();
      renderProductTabProductPicker();
      renderPitchCountStats();
      renderVisitFrequencyStats();
      renderTotalSpendStats();

      updateAppliedBanner();
      updateKpis();
      if(document.getElementById('productView')?.classList.contains('active')) renderProductInsight();

      hydratePitchSummaryForCurrentRows().catch(()=>{});
    }

    function setSelectedByPredicate(pred){
      // legacy compatibility: แปลง predicate เก่าให้เป็นชั้นกรองแบบ custom แทน selectedKeys
      addFilterLayer({type:'custom', label:'ฟิลเตอร์กำหนดเอง', pred});
    }
    function scrollToFinal(){
      const el = document.getElementById('finalSection');
      if(el && el.scrollIntoView) el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
    }
    function updateAppliedBanner(){
      const b = document.getElementById('appliedBanner');
      if(!b) return;
      updateFilterResultsText();
      const layers = Array.isArray(state.filterLayers) ? state.filterLayers : [];
      state.appliedNote = describeFilterLayers();
      const search = String(state.tableSearch || '').trim();
      const bits = [];
      if(layers.length){
        bits.push(`<div style="margin-bottom:6px;">กำลังกรองซ้อน ${layers.length} ชั้น</div>`);
        bits.push(`<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;">`);
        layers.forEach((layer,i)=>{
          bits.push(`<span class="badge b-ok" style="gap:4px;">${i+1}. ${esc(layerLabel(layer,i))} <button type="button" class="icon-btn" style="padding:1px 6px;font-size:10px;" onclick="editFilterLayer(${i});event.stopPropagation();">แก้</button> <button type="button" class="icon-btn" style="padding:1px 6px;font-size:10px;" onclick="removeFilterLayer(${i});event.stopPropagation();">ลบ</button></span>`);
        });
        bits.push(`<button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" style="padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px;" onclick="clearFilterLayers();event.stopPropagation();">ล้างชั้นกรอง</button>`);
        bits.push(`</div>`);
      }
      if(search){
        bits.push(`<div style="margin-top:6px;">ค้นหาในผลลัพธ์: <b>${esc(search)}</b></div>`);
      }
      if(state.partyFilterOpds instanceof Set){
        bits.push(`<div style="margin-top:6px;">ใช้ Party Focus อยู่</div>`);
      }
      if(bits.length){ b.innerHTML = bits.join(''); b.style.display='block'; }
      else { b.innerHTML=''; b.style.display='none'; }
    }

    function applyRecency(min,max,label){
      const minN = Number(min || 0);
      const maxN = numOrInfinity(max);
      const display = `${label} วัน`;
      const run = () => addFilterLayer({type:'recency', min:minN, max:maxN, display, label:`Recency ${display}`});
      // ให้ browser วาด loading ก่อน แล้วค่อยคำนวณกลุ่มใหญ่ เช่น 365 ขึ้นไป ลดอาการเหมือนค้าง
      if(maxN === Infinity || minN >= 365){
        showLoading(true);
        setTimeout(()=>{
          try{ run(); }
          finally{ setTimeout(()=>showLoading(false), 150); }
        }, 0);
      }else{
        run();
      }
    }
    function applyABC(cls){
      addFilterLayer({type:'abc', value:String(cls || '').toUpperCase(), label:`ABC ชั้น ${String(cls || '').toUpperCase()}`});
    }
    function applyRFM(segTH){
      addFilterLayer({type:'rfm', value:segTH, label:`RFM: ${segTH}`});
    }
    function applySpend(min,max,label){
      addFilterLayer({type:'spend', min:Number(min || 0), max:numOrInfinity(max), display:label, label:`AOV ${label}`});
    }
    function applyServiceGroupFilter(key){
      const k = String(key || '');
      addFilterLayer({type:'serviceGroup', key:k, label:`บริการ: ${serviceGroupLabel(k)}`});
    }
    function applyVisitFrequency(min, max, label){
      addFilterLayer({type:'visitFrequency', min:Number(min || 0), max:numOrInfinity(max), display:label, label:`ความถี่ ${label}`});
    }
    function applyTotalSpend(min, max, label){
      addFilterLayer({type:'totalSpend', min:Number(min || 0), max:numOrInfinity(max), display:label, label:`ยอดสะสม ${label}`});
    }

    function applyNameColorFilter(color){
      const c = normalizeCustomerNameColor(color);
      addFilterLayer({type:'nameColor', color:c, label:`สีชื่อ: ${nameColorText(c)}`});
    }
    async function applyPitchOutcomeFilter(category){
      const cat = String(category || '');
      const opds = [...currentCustomers().values()].map(v=>pad4(v.opd || '')).filter(Boolean);
      showLoading(true);
      try{
        await fetchPitchSummaryBatch(opds);
        addFilterLayer({type:'pitchOutcome', category:cat, label:`Pitch: ${pitchOutcomeCategoryText(cat)}`});
      }finally{
        showLoading(false);
      }
    }

    async function applyPitchCountFilter(min, max, label){
      const minN = Number(min || 0);
      const maxN = numOrInfinity(max);
      const display = String(label || `${minN}–${maxN}`);
      const opds = [...currentCustomers().values()].map(v=>pad4(v.opd || '')).filter(Boolean);
      showLoading(true);
      try{
        await fetchPitchSummaryBatch(opds);
        addFilterLayer({type:'pitchCount', min:minN, max:maxN, display, label:`จำนวน Pitch ${display}`});
      }finally{
        setTimeout(()=>showLoading(false), 120);
      }
    }

    function applyWeekdayDetail(weekday, bucketKey, label){
      addFilterLayer({type:'weekday', weekday:Number(weekday), bucketKey:bucketKey || 'all', display:label || weekdayNamesTH[weekday], label:`รายได้วัน${label || weekdayNamesTH[weekday]}`});
    }

    function applyAgeBucket(min, max, label){
      addFilterLayer({type:'age', min:Number(min || 0), max:numOrInfinity(max), display:`${label} ปี`, label:`ช่วงอายุ ${label} ปี`});
    }

    function setQuickRange(preset){
      const end = new Date();
      let start = new Date(2000,0,1);
      if(preset==='thisMonth'){ start = new Date(end.getFullYear(), end.getMonth(), 1);
      }else if(preset==='2m'){ start = new Date(end.getFullYear(), end.getMonth()-1, 1);
      }else if(preset==='3m'){ start = new Date(end.getFullYear(), end.getMonth()-2, 1);
      }else if(preset==='6m'){ start = new Date(end.getFullYear(), end.getMonth()-5, 1);
      }else if(preset==='thisYear'){ start = new Date(end.getFullYear(), 0, 1);
      }else if(preset==='all'){ start = new Date(2000,0,1); }
      document.getElementById('startDate').value = ymdLocal(start);
      document.getElementById('endDate').value   = ymdLocal(end);
    }

    function applyAbsentChip(range){
      let min=0, max=Infinity, label=range;
      if(range.includes('+')){
        min=parseInt(range); max=Infinity;
        label = (min===365? '1 ปีขึ้นไป' : `${min}+`);
      } else {
        const [a,b]=range.split('-');
        min=parseInt(a); max=parseInt(b);
        label=`${a}–${b}`;
      }

      // Quick recency ใช้ฐานข้อมูลทั้งหมดเป็นฐาน แต่ไม่ render รอบแรกทิ้ง เพราะกลุ่มใหญ่จะค้างจากการ render/fetch ซ้อนกัน
      setQuickRange('all');
      applyRange({render:false});
      applyRecency(min, max, label);
    }

    /* Range modal hooks */
    function openRangeModal(){
      const s = document.getElementById('startDate').value;
      const e = document.getElementById('endDate').value;
      document.getElementById('rangeStartModal').value = s || '';
      document.getElementById('rangeEndModal').value = e || '';
      document.getElementById('rangeModal').style.display = 'block';
    }
    function closeRangeModal(){ document.getElementById('rangeModal').style.display = 'none'; }
    function applyRangeFromModal(){
      const s = document.getElementById('rangeStartModal').value;
      const e = document.getElementById('rangeEndModal').value;
      if(!s || !e){ alert('กรุณาเลือกวันที่เริ่มและสิ้นสุด'); return; }
      if(parseYmdLocal(s) > parseYmdLocal(e)){ alert('วันเริ่มต้องไม่เกินวันสิ้นสุด'); return; }
      document.getElementById('startDate').value = s;
      document.getElementById('endDate').value = e;
      closeRangeModal();
      state.appliedNote=''; state.reconApplySpecial=null;
      state.selectedKeys=null;
      applyRange();
    }

    /* Table sort click */
    document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const th = e.target.closest('#finalCustTable thead th');
      if(!th || !th.dataset.sort) return;
      const idx = Array.from(th.parentNode.children).indexOf(th);
      if(idx===0) return;
      state.finalSort.dir = (state.finalSort.col===idx? -state.finalSort.dir : 1);
      state.finalSort.col = idx;
      renderFinalTable();
    });

    /* Click pitch cell to open history */
    document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      if(e.target.closest('#dashboardProductPicker') || e.target.closest('#productTabProductPicker') || e.target.closest('#productPickerPopup')) return;
      if(state.productPickerPopupOpen) closeProductPickerPopup();
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
      if(e.key === 'Escape' && state.productPickerPopupOpen) closeProductPickerPopup();
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const cell = e.target.closest('#finalCustTable td.lp-cell');
      if(!cell) return;
      const tr = cell.closest('tr');
      if(!tr) return;
      const opd = tr.getAttribute('data-opd') || '';
      const nameCell = tr.querySelector('td:nth-child(3)');
      const displayName = nameCell ? nameCell.textContent.trim() : opd;
      if(!opd){ alert('ไม่พบ OPD ของลูกค้า'); return; }
      openPitchModalForOPD(opd, displayName);
    });

    /* Search: กรองข้อมูลจริง ไม่ใช่แค่ซ่อนแถว */
    document.addEventListener('input', (e)=>{
      if(e.target && e.target.id==='qSearch'){
        state.tableSearch = e.target.value || '';
        invalidateCurrentCustomersCache();
        clearTimeout(state.searchTimer);
        state.searchTimer = setTimeout(()=>{
          renderAll();
        }, 220);
      }
    });

    /* Profile inline edit ถูกเอาออกจากหน้านี้ เพื่อลดความเสี่ยงแก้ข้อมูลลูกค้าผิดบนมือถือ */

    /* KPI click actions */
    document.getElementById('kpiCustomers')?.addEventListener('click', ()=> scrollToFinal());
    document.getElementById('kpiRisk')?.addEventListener('click', ()=> applyRecency(90, Infinity, '90+'));
    document.getElementById('kpiAClass')?.addEventListener('click', ()=> applyABC('A'));

    /* Buttons */
    document.getElementById('btnApply').addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
      showLoading(true);
      try{ applyRange(); }
      finally{ setTimeout(()=>showLoading(false), 150); }
    });
    document.getElementById('openCustomRange').addEventListener('click', openRangeModal);
    document.getElementById('btnAddProduct').addEventListener('click', addProductSelect);
    document.getElementById('btnRunAdv').addEventListener('click', filterGeneral);
    document.getElementById('btnResetAdv').addEventListener('click', resetFilters);

    /* Chips */
    document.querySelectorAll('.chip[data-range]').forEach(chip=>{
      chip.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        document.querySelectorAll('.chip[data-range]').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('active'));
        chip.classList.add('active');
        const preset = chip.getAttribute('data-range');
        state.appliedNote=''; state.reconApplySpecial=null;
        state.selectedKeys=null;
        if(preset === 'customRange'){
          openRangeModal();
          return;
        }
        if(preset.startsWith('abs:')){
          applyAbsentChip(preset.replace('abs:',''));
        }else{
          setQuickRange(preset);
          applyRange();
        }
      });
    });

    function exportFilteredSummary(){
      if(!state.finalRows.length){
        toast('ไม่มีข้อมูลให้โหลด', 'warn');
        return;
      }

      // ใช้ข้อมูลหลังฟิลเตอร์ปัจจุบันตาม state.finalRows ที่แสดงในตารางลูกค้า
      const rows = state.finalRows || [];
      const totalCustomers = rows.length;
      const totalRevenue = rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+Number(r.total||0),0);
      const totalVisits = rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+Number(r.visits||0),0);
      const avgBill = totalVisits ? Math.round(totalRevenue / totalVisits) : 0;
      const avgPerCustomer = totalCustomers ? Math.round(totalRevenue / totalCustomers) : 0;
      const risk90 = rows.filter(r=>Number(r.recency||0) >= 90).length;
      const aClass = rows.filter(r=>String(r.abc||'').toUpperCase()==='A').length;
      const vipCount = rows.filter(r=>r.contactInfo?.isVIP).length;

      const countBy = (arr, getter) => {
        const m = new Map();
        for(const x of arr){
          const k = getter(x) || '-';
          m.set(k, (m.get(k)||0)+1);
        }
        return Array.from(m.entries()).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
      };
      const sumBy = (arr, getter) => {
        const m = new Map();
        for(const x of arr){
          const k = getter(x) || '-';
          const o = m.get(k) || {n:0, revenue:0, visits:0};
          o.n += 1;
          o.revenue += Number(x.total||0);
          o.visits += Number(x.visits||0);
          m.set(k, o);
        }
        return Array.from(m.entries()).map(([k,o])=>({key:k, ...o})).sort((a,b)=>b.n-a.n);
      };

      const statusRows = sumBy(rows, r=>r.contactInfo?.status || '-');
      const rfmRows = sumBy(rows, r=>r.rfm || '-');
      const abcRows = sumBy(rows, r=>r.abc || '-');
      const recRows = recencyBuckets.map(b=>{
        const arr = rows.filter(r=>Number(r.recency||0) >= b.min && Number(r.recency||0) <= b.max);
        return {key:b.label, n:arr.length, revenue:arr.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.total||0),0), visits:arr.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.visits||0),0)};
      });
      const spendRows = spendBands.map(b=>{
        const arr = rows.filter(r=>Number(r.avg||0) >= b.min && Number(r.avg||0) <= b.max);
        return {key:b.label, n:arr.length, revenue:arr.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.total||0),0), visits:arr.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.visits||0),0)};
      });

      const start = document.getElementById('startDate')?.value || '';
      const end = document.getElementById('endDate')?.value || '';
      const search = state.tableSearch || document.getElementById('qSearch')?.value || '';
      const note = describeFilterLayers() || (state.partyFilterOpds instanceof Set ? 'Party Focus' : 'ตามฟิลเตอร์ปัจจุบัน');
      const downloadedAt = new Date().toLocaleString('th-TH');

      const h = v => esc(v == null ? '' : String(v));
      const money = v => Math.round(Number(v||0)).toLocaleString('th-TH');
      const pct = n => totalCustomers ? (Number(n||0)*100/totalCustomers).toFixed(1)+'%' : '0.0%';
      const cell = v => h(v);
      const table = (title, header, bodyRows) => `
        <h2>${h(title)}</h2>
        <table>
          <thead><tr>${header.map(x=>`<th>${h(x)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            ${bodyRows.map(r=>`<tr>${r.map(c=>`<td>${cell(c)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="${header.length}">ไม่มีข้อมูล</td></tr>`}
          </tbody>
        </table>`;

      const summaryTable = table('สรุปภาพรวมจากฟิลเตอร์', ['หัวข้อ','ค่า'], [
        ['ช่วงวันที่', `${start || '-'} ถึง ${end || '-'}`],
        ['ฟิลเตอร์/เงื่อนไข', note],
        ['คำค้นหาในตาราง', search || '-'],
        ['จำนวนลูกค้า', totalCustomers.toLocaleString('th-TH')],
        ['จำนวนครั้ง/บิล', totalVisits.toLocaleString('th-TH')],
        ['ยอดรวม', money(totalRevenue)],
        ['เฉลี่ยต่อบิล', money(avgBill)],
        ['เฉลี่ยต่อคน', money(avgPerCustomer)],
        ['ลูกค้าไม่ได้มา 90+ วัน', risk90.toLocaleString('th-TH')],
        ['ลูกค้าชั้น A', aClass.toLocaleString('th-TH')],
        ['VIP/มูลค่าสูง', vipCount.toLocaleString('th-TH')],
        ['โหลดเมื่อ', downloadedAt],
      ]);

      const statusTable = table('สถานะติดต่อ / เหตุผล CRM', ['สถานะ','จำนวนลูกค้า','% ลูกค้า','จำนวนครั้ง/บิล','ยอดรวม'],
        statusRows.map(x=>[x.key, x.n, pct(x.n), x.visits, money(x.revenue)])
      );
      const rfmTable = table('กลุ่มลูกค้า RFM', ['กลุ่ม','จำนวนลูกค้า','% ลูกค้า','จำนวนครั้ง/บิล','ยอดรวม'],
        rfmRows.map(x=>[x.key, x.n, pct(x.n), x.visits, money(x.revenue)])
      );
      const abcTable = table('ABC ตามยอดรวม', ['ชั้น','จำนวนลูกค้า','% ลูกค้า','จำนวนครั้ง/บิล','ยอดรวม'],
        abcRows.map(x=>[x.key, x.n, pct(x.n), x.visits, money(x.revenue)])
      );
      const recTable = table('สรุปตามจำนวนวันที่ไม่ได้มา', ['ช่วงวัน','จำนวนลูกค้า','% ลูกค้า','จำนวนครั้ง/บิล','ยอดรวม'],
        recRows.map(x=>[x.key, x.n, pct(x.n), x.visits, money(x.revenue)])
      );
      const spendTable = table('สรุปตามค่าเฉลี่ย/บิล', ['ช่วง AOV','จำนวนลูกค้า','% ลูกค้า','จำนวนครั้ง/บิล','ยอดรวม'],
        spendRows.map(x=>[x.key, x.n, pct(x.n), x.visits, money(x.revenue)])
      );

      const detailTable = table('รายชื่อลูกค้าตามฟิลเตอร์',
        ['ลำดับ','OPD','ชื่อ','จำนวนครั้ง','ยอดรวม','เฉลี่ย/บิล','ไม่ได้มา(วัน)','RFM','ABC','Pitch ล่าสุด(วัน)','สถานะติดต่อ','เหตุผล'],
        rows.map((r,i)=>[
          i+1,
          r.v.opd || '',
          r.v.name || '',
          r.visits || 0,
          money(r.total || 0),
          money(r.avg || 0),
          r.recency || 0,
          r.rfm || '',
          r.abc || '',
          r.lastPitchDays == null ? 'ไม่เคย' : r.lastPitchDays,
          r.contactInfo?.status || '',
          r.contactInfo?.reason || '',
        ])
      );

      const html = `<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<style>
  body{font-family:Tahoma,'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif;font-size:12px;color:#111827;}
  h1{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 8px;color:#0f766e;}
  h2{font-size:14px;margin:18px 0 6px;color:#0f766e;}
  .note{color:#64748b;margin-bottom:12px;}
  table{border-collapse:collapse;margin-bottom:14px;width:100%;}
  th{background:#e6fffb;color:#0f766e;font-weight:700;}
  th,td{border:1px solid #d1d5db;padding:6px 8px;vertical-align:top;mso-number-format:'\\@';}
</style>
<style>html{scroll-behavior:auto!important}#adminFloatingToggle{display:none!important}.preview-data-label{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:12px;z-index:2147483647;background:#0e4840;color:white;border-radius:100px;padding:6px 12px;font:12px sans-serif;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #0002}</style></head><body>
  <h1>สรุปวิเคราะห์ลูกค้า</h1>
  <div class="note">ไฟล์นี้สร้างจากฟิลเตอร์ที่ใช้อยู่ในหน้า วิเคราะห์ลูกค้า ณ เวลาที่กดโหลด</div>
  ${summaryTable}
  ${statusTable}
  ${rfmTable}
  ${abcTable}
  ${recTable}
  ${spendTable}
  ${detailTable}
<div class="preview-data-label">หน้าจอจากระบบจริง · ข้อมูลสมมติ</div></body></html>`;

      const blob = new Blob(['\ufeff', html], {type:'application/vnd.ms-excel;charset=utf-8'});
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `customer_summary_filtered_${ymdLocal(new Date())}.xls`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      toast('โหลดสรุปข้อมูลแล้ว', 'ok');
    }

    /* Export CSV */
    function exportFinalCsv(){
      if(!state.finalRows.length){
        toast('ไม่มีข้อมูลให้ export', 'warn');
        return;
      }
      const header = ['OPD','ชื่อ','จำนวนครั้ง','ยอดรวม','เฉลี่ย/บิล','ไม่ได้มา(วัน)','RFM','ABC','Pitchล่าสุด(วัน)'];
      const lines = [header];

      for(const r of state.finalRows){
        lines.push([
          r.v.opd||'',
          r.v.name||'',
          r.visits||0,
          Math.round(r.total||0),
          r.avg||0,
          r.recency||0,
          r.rfm||'',
          r.abc||'',
          (r.lastPitchDays==null?'ไม่เคย':r.lastPitchDays)
        ]);
      }

      const csv = lines.map(row => row.map(cell=>{
        const s = String(cell ?? '');
        if(/[",\n]/.test(s)) return `"${s.replace(/"/g,'""')}"`;
        return s;
      }).join(',')).join('\n');

      const blob = new Blob([csv], {type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `customers_${ymdLocal(new Date())}.csv`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      toast('Export CSV แล้ว', 'ok');
    }
    document.getElementById('btnExportFilteredSummary')?.addEventListener('click', exportFilteredSummary);
    document.getElementById('btnExportCsv').addEventListener('click', exportFinalCsv);

    /* Modals */
    function closeCustomerModal(){ document.getElementById('customer-modal').style.display='none'; }
    document.getElementById('customer-modal').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const box = document.querySelector('#customer-modal .box');
      if(box && !box.contains(e.target)) closeCustomerModal();
    });

    function closePitchModal(){
      const m = document.getElementById('pitch-modal');
      if(m) m.style.display='none';
    }
    document.getElementById('pitch-modal')?.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const box = e.target.closest('.box');
      if(!box) closePitchModal();
    });

    function fmtDateTime(iso){
      if(!iso) return '';
      const d = new Date(iso);
      if(isNaN(d)) return iso;
      const y=d.getFullYear(), m=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'), dd=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
      const hh=String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0'), mm=String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
      return `${dd}/${m}/${String(y).slice(-2)} ${hh}:${mm}`;
    }

    function customerSnapshotByOpd(opd){
      return state.customerDataByOpd.get(pad4(opd || '')) || {};
    }
    function compactJoin(parts){
      return (parts || []).map(x=>String(x || '').trim()).filter(Boolean).join(' • ');
    }
    function customerCardCommentHtml(opd){
      const c = customerSnapshotByOpd(opd);
      const color = String(c.name_color || 'green').toLowerCase();
      const dot = color === 'gold' ? '💎' : color === 'red' ? '🔴' : color === 'orange' ? '🟠' : '🟢';
      const main = String(c.name_color_note || '').trim() || (color === 'gold' ? 'VIP หมอดูแลเอง / ห้ามเซลแตะต้อง' : '-');
      const fu = compactJoin([
        c.last_followup_status,
        c.last_followup_comment,
        c.last_followup_score ? `${c.last_followup_score}/10` : ''
      ]);
      const pitch = compactJoin([c.last_pitch_outcome, c.last_pitch_comment]);
      const line = (icon, text) => text ? `<div class="customer-card-comment-line"><span>${icon}</span><b>${esc(text)}</b></div>` : '';
      return `
        <div class="customer-card-comments">
          ${line(dot, main)}
          ${line('🟡', fu)}
          ${line('💬', pitch)}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    async function openPitchModalForOPD(opd, displayName){
      try{
        const r = await fetch(`/api/pitches?opd=${encodeURIComponent(opd)}`);
        if(!r.ok){ alert('โหลดประวัติ Pitch ไม่สำเร็จ'); return; }
        const rows = await r.json() || [];
        const count = rows.length;

        rows.sort((a,b)=> String(b.created_at||'').localeCompare(String(a.created_at||'')));

        const table = rows.map((p,idx)=>`
          <tr>
            <td>${idx+1}</td>
            <td>${fmtDateTime(p.created_at||'')}</td>
            <td>${esc(p.channel||'-')}</td>
            <td>${esc(p.promotion||'-')}</td>
            <td>${esc(p.outcome||'-')}</td>
            <td>${esc(p.content||'-')}</td>
            <td>${esc(p.author||'-')}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="7" class="sub-muted">ยังไม่มีประวัติการ Pitch</td></tr>`;

        const html = `
          <div style="margin-bottom:10px">
            <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:900;color:#064e3b">ประวัติการ Pitch — ${esc(displayName||opd)}</div>
            <div class="sub-muted">รวมทั้งหมด <b>${count.toLocaleString()}</b> ครั้ง</div>
          </div>
          <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; background:#fff">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style="width:48px">#</th>
                <th>วันที่</th>
                <th>ช่องทาง</th>
                <th>โปรโมชั่น</th>
                <th>Outcome</th>
                <th>Comment</th>
                <th>ผู้บันทึก</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>${table}</tbody>
          </table>
        `;
        document.getElementById('pitch-modal-content').innerHTML = html;
        document.getElementById('pitch-modal').style.display='flex';
      }catch(e){
        console.error(e);
        alert('เกิดข้อผิดพลาดในการโหลดข้อมูล Pitch');
      }
    }

    function openDashboardFullscreen(type){
      const meta = {
        weekday: {
          title: 'สถิติรายได้แยกวัน 7 วัน',
          hint: 'แสดงจำนวนลูกค้า / จำนวนบิล / ยอดขาย แยกตามช่วงวันที่ 1–10, 11–20, 21–สิ้นเดือน',
          selector: '[data-dash-card="weekday"] .table-wrap'
        },
        age: {
          title: 'สถิติช่วงอายุ',
          hint: 'อิงเฉพาะลูกค้าที่มีข้อมูลปีเกิด กดปุ่มดูเพื่อกรองรายชื่อช่วงอายุนั้น',
          selector: '[data-dash-card="age"] .table-wrap'
        },
        nameColor: {
          title: 'สีชื่อลูกค้า ตาม OPD',
          hint: 'นับจาก customers.name_color ตาม OPD และล้อไปตามฟิลเตอร์ที่ใช้อยู่',
          selector: '[data-dash-card="nameColor"] .table-wrap'
        },
        pitchOutcome: {
          title: 'ผลการ Pitch ล่าสุด',
          hint: 'นับผล Pitch ล่าสุดตาม OPD และล้อไปตามฟิลเตอร์ที่ใช้อยู่',
          selector: '[data-dash-card="pitchOutcome"] .table-wrap'
        },
        serviceGroup: {
          title: 'สินค้า/บริการที่เคยซื้อ',
          hint: 'เลือกสินค้า/บริการย่อยด้วย checkbox หรือกด 👁 เพื่อกรองต่อได้ รายการยาวจะเลื่อนในกล่อง',
          selector: '[data-dash-card="serviceGroup"] .table-wrap'
        },
        pitchCount: {
          title: 'จำนวนการ Pitch',
          hint: 'แบ่งลูกค้าตามจำนวนครั้งที่มีบันทึก Pitch ตาม OPD และกดดูเพื่อกรองต่อได้',
          selector: '[data-dash-card="pitchCount"] .table-wrap'
        },
        visitFrequency: {
          title: 'ความถี่การกลับมาซื้อ',
          hint: 'แยกลูกค้าตามจำนวนบิล/ครั้งที่กลับมาซื้อในช่วงข้อมูลที่เลือก',
          selector: '[data-dash-card="visitFrequency"] .table-wrap'
        },
        totalSpend: {
          title: 'ยอดใช้จ่ายสะสม',
          hint: 'แบ่งกลุ่มตามยอดใช้จ่ายรวมของลูกค้าในผลลัพธ์ปัจจุบัน',
          selector: '[data-dash-card="totalSpend"] .table-wrap'
        }
      }[type];
      if(!meta) return;

      const source = document.querySelector(meta.selector);
      const modal = document.getElementById('dashboard-fullscreen-modal');
      const body = document.getElementById('dashboardFullBody');
      const title = document.getElementById('dashboardFullTitle');
      const hint = document.getElementById('dashboardFullHint');
      if(!source || !modal || !body) return;

      const clone = source.cloneNode(true);
      clone.querySelectorAll('[id]').forEach(el => el.removeAttribute('id'));
      clone.querySelectorAll('.dash-openable').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('dash-openable'));

      title.textContent = meta.title;
      hint.textContent = meta.hint;
      body.innerHTML = '';
      body.appendChild(clone);
      modal.classList.add('show');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function closeDashboardFullscreen(event){
      if(event && event.target && event.target.id !== 'dashboard-fullscreen-modal') return;
      const modal = document.getElementById('dashboard-fullscreen-modal');
      const body = document.getElementById('dashboardFullBody');
      if(modal) modal.classList.remove('show');
      if(body) body.innerHTML = '';
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
      if(e.key === 'Escape') closeDashboardFullscreen();
    });

    /* Customer modal: ใช้เทมเพลตกลางเป็นหลัก (เหมือนหน้าอื่น) */
    async function openCustomerModal(key) {
      if(window.openCustomerProfile && window.openCustomerProfile !== openCustomerModal){
        return window.openCustomerProfile(key);
      }
      let cust = state.customersMap.get(key);

      if (!cust) {
        const rawKey = String(key || '').trim();
        let recs = [];

        if(rawKey.startsWith('OPD:') || /^\d{1,4}$/.test(rawKey)){
          const opd = pad4(rawKey.replace(/^OPD:/,''));
          recs = state.allSales.filter(r => pad4(r.opd || '') === opd);
        }else{
          const [name, phone = ''] = rawKey.split('|');
          const norm = s => (s || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          recs = state.allSales.filter(r =>
            norm(r.name) === norm(name) &&
            norm(r.phone || '') === norm(phone)
          );
        }

        if (!recs.length) return;

        recs.sort((a,b)=> String(a.date||'').localeCompare(String(b.date||'')));
        const first = recs[0] || {};
        cust = {
          key: keyForCustomer(first),
          name: first.name,
          phone: first.phone || '',
          opd: pad4(first.opd || ''),
          bills: recs.slice()
        };
      }

      const records = cust.bills.slice().sort((a, b) => String(b.date||'').localeCompare(String(a.date||'')));

      const customer = {
        name: cust.name,
        phone: cust.phone || '-',
        opd: cust.opd || '-'
      };

      const latestRecord = records[0];
      const lastDateStr = (latestRecord?.date || '').slice(0, 10);

      const baseDate = state.endAnchorDate || new Date();
      const lastDate = parseYmdLocal(lastDateStr);
      const daysAbsent = !lastDate ? 0 : Math.floor((baseDate - lastDate) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

      const totalVisits = records.length;

      const paidRecords = records.filter(r => recordAmount(r) > 0);
      const paidVisits = paidRecords.length;
      const totalAmount = paidRecords.reduce((s, r) => s + recordAmount(r), 0);
      const average = paidVisits > 0 ? Math.round(totalAmount / paidVisits) : 0;

      const allItems = {};
      records.forEach(r => {
        normalizeItemsArray(r.items).forEach(item => {
          const it = parseSaleItem(item);
          const name = it.display || it.label || '-';
          const qty = it.qty || 1;
          allItems[name] = (allItems[name] || 0) + qty;
        });
      });

      const categoryMap = {
        "โบทอค": ["Aestox 50 u","Aestox 100 u","Allergan 50 u","Allergan 100 u","เฉพาะจุด","แบ่งไว้แล้ว","Nabota"],
        "ฟิลเลอร์": ["Neuramis สีดำ","Neuramis สีทอง","E.P.T.Q ระบุสีด้วย","Restylane ระบุสีด้วย"],
        "Fat/Hifu": ["Bromi","Sisi","HIFU","HIFU แถม"],
        "งานผิว": [
          "Meso Chanel","P - Cell","Aquatic","Hestina","Exosome","Rejuran",
          "Belotero Revive","Sculptra","Juvelook","Aesthefill","PRP","Mesowink",
          "สะกิดหน้าใส","Alphaarbutin","Transamine","Biocollagen"
        ],
        "ดริปผิว": ["Snow White","Super Aurawhite","Vitamin Mix","Brain Booster","Energy Booster"],
        "ทรีทเม้นท์": [
          "ทรีทเมนต์หน้าใส","ทรีทเมนต์สิว","ทรีทเมนต์ฝ้า",
          "ผลักวิตามิน","ปั่น RF","กดสิว","subcisionสิว"
        ],
        "อื่นๆ": [
          "ยาฉีดสลายฝ้า","ครีมทาฝ้า","ยาทานฝ้า",
          "ไหมลิฟท์กรอบหน้า","ไหม PDO","ไหม Collagen",
          "จ่ายเงิน/จองสินค้า","สลายฟิลเลอร์","PRPผม","จี้ไฝ"
        ],
        "โปรโมชั่น/อีเว้นพิเศษ": []
      };

      const categorizedItems = {};
      for (const [cat, names] of Object.entries(categoryMap)) {
        names.forEach(n => {
          if (allItems[n]) {
            (categorizedItems[cat] ||= []).push(`${n} : ${allItems[n]}`);
            delete allItems[n];
          }
        });
      }
      if (Object.keys(allItems).length) {
        (categorizedItems["อื่นๆ"] ||= []).push(
          ...Object.entries(allItems).map(([n, q]) => `${n} : ${q}`)
        );
      }

      const itemSummary = Object.entries(categorizedItems)
        .map(([cat, items]) => `
          <div style="margin-bottom:6px;">
            <strong>${cat}</strong>: ${items.join(" | ")}
          </div>
        `).join("");

      const historyHtml = records.map(r => {
        const items = normalizeItemsArray(r.items).map(item => {
          const it = parseSaleItem(item);
          const name = it.display || it.label || '-';
          const qty = it.qty || 1;
          return `<li>${esc(name)} : ${qty}</li>`;
        }).join("");

        const noteText = r.note
          ? `<div style="font-size:11px; margin-top:2px; font-style:italic; color:#444;">
               📝 หมายเหตุ: ${esc(r.note)}
             </div>`
          : "";

        return `
          <div style="margin-bottom:14px;">
            <div style="font-weight:900; font-size:12px;color:#064e3b">
              📅 ${formatDate((r.date || '').slice(0,10))}
            </div>
            <ul style="padding-left:16px; margin:6px 0 0; font-size:11px;">${items}</ul>
            <div style="margin-top:6px; color:#0a645a; font-size:11px;font-weight:900">
              💵 ${Math.round(recordAmount(r)).toLocaleString()} บาท
            </div>
            ${noteText}
            <hr style="margin:10px auto; border:0; border-top:1px dashed #ddd; width:70%;">
          </div>
        `;
      }).join("");

      const customerSnapshot = customerSnapshotByOpd(customer.opd);
      const pitchSectionHtml = compactJoin([customerSnapshot.last_pitch_outcome, customerSnapshot.last_pitch_comment])
        ? `<div style="padding:4px 0; font-size:11px; color:#374151;">${esc(compactJoin([customerSnapshot.last_pitch_outcome, customerSnapshot.last_pitch_comment]))}</div>`
        : `<div class="sub-muted" style="font-size:11px;">-</div>`;

      const daysAbsentText = `<span style="color:#ef4444;font-weight:900;">(ไม่ได้มาแล้ว: ${daysAbsent} วัน)</span>`;

      const profileImg = await fetchProfileImage(customer.opd);
      document.getElementById("modal-content").innerHTML = `
        <div class="party-modal-layout">
          <div>${profileImg ? `<img class="party-profile-img" src="${esc(profileImg)}" alt="รูปโปรไฟล์ลูกค้า">` : `<div class="party-profile-img" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#94a3b8;font-weight:900;">ไม่มีรูป</div>`}</div>
          <div>
            <h3 style="font-size:16px; margin:0 0 6px;color:#064e3b;font-weight:900;">📇 ${esc(customer.name)}</h3>
            <div style="font-size:12px;">🆔 OPD: <b>${esc(customer.opd)}</b></div>
            <div style="font-size:12px;">📞 เบอร์: ${esc(customer.phone)}</div>
            <div style="font-size:12px;">📅 วันล่าสุด: ${formatDate(lastDateStr)} ${daysAbsentText}</div>
            <div style="font-size:12px; color:#00796b;font-weight:900;margin-top:6px;">💰 ยอดรวมทั้งหมด: ${Math.round(totalAmount).toLocaleString()} บาท</div>
            <div style="font-size:12px;">🔁 จำนวนครั้ง: ${totalVisits} ครั้ง (${paidVisits} ครั้งจ่ายเงิน)</div>
            <div style="font-size:12px;">💳 เฉลี่ยต่อครั้ง: ${average.toLocaleString()} บาท</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        ${customerCardCommentHtml(customer.opd)}

        <div class="party-mini-tabs">
          <button class="party-mini-tab active" data-customer-modal-tab="overview">ภาพรวม</button>
          <button class="party-mini-tab" data-customer-modal-tab="party">ปาตี้</button>
        </div>

        <div data-customer-modal-panel="overview">
          <hr style="margin:14px 0; border:0; border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;">
          <div style="font-weight:900; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:8px;color:#064e3b;">📦 สรุปรายการซื้อทั้งหมด</div>
          <div style="font-size:11px;">${itemSummary || '-'}</div>
          <hr style="margin:14px 0; border:0; border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;">
          <div style="font-weight:900; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:6px;color:#064e3b;">💬 Sale Pitch ล่าสุด</div>
          ${pitchSectionHtml}
          <hr style="margin:14px 0; border:0; border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;">
          <div style="font-weight:900; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:8px;color:#064e3b;">🧾 ประวัติการซื้อย้อนหลัง</div>
          ${historyHtml}
        </div>
        <div data-customer-modal-panel="party" style="display:none;">
          <div style="font-weight:900; font-size:13px; margin:10px 0;color:#064e3b;">🎯 ปาตี้ของลูกค้าคนนี้</div>
          <div id="modalPartyMembershipBox" class="party-membership-list"></div>
        </div>
      `;

      document.querySelectorAll('[data-customer-modal-tab]').forEach(btn=>{
        btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
          const tab = btn.dataset.customerModalTab;
          document.querySelectorAll('[data-customer-modal-tab]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active', b===btn));
          document.querySelectorAll('[data-customer-modal-panel]').forEach(p=>p.style.display = p.dataset.customerModalPanel===tab ? '' : 'none');
          if(tab==='party') renderCustomerPartyPanel(customer.opd, customer.name, customer.phone);
        });
      });

      document.getElementById("customer-modal").style.display = 'flex';
    }


    /* ==========================
       Party Focus: manual focus groups
       ========================== */
    async function apiParty(url, options={}){
      const res = await fetch(url, options);
      const data = await res.json().catch(()=>({}));
      if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
      return data;
    }

    async function refreshPartyFocus(){
      try{
        const data = await apiParty('/api/party_focus');
        state.partyGroups = data.groups || [];
        renderPartySelectors();
        if(state.selectedPartyId){
          await loadPartyMembers(state.selectedPartyId);
        }
      }catch(e){
        console.warn(e);
      }
    }

    function renderPartySelectors(){
      const opts = ['<option value="">ทุกปาตี้ / ไม่กรอง</option>']
        .concat((state.partyGroups||[]).map(g=>`<option value="${esc(g.id)}">${esc(g.name)} (${Number(g.member_count||0).toLocaleString()})</option>`)).join('');
      const sel = document.getElementById('partyFilterSelect');
      if(sel){
        sel.innerHTML = opts;
        sel.value = state.partyFilterId || '';
      }
    }

    async function loadPartyMembers(partyId){
      if(!partyId) return [];
      const data = await apiParty(`/api/party_focus/${encodeURIComponent(partyId)}/members`);
      const rows = data.members || [];
      state.partyMembersByGroup.set(partyId, rows);
      return rows;
    }

    function renderPartyFocus(){
      const list = document.getElementById('partyListBox');
      if(list){
        list.innerHTML = (state.partyGroups||[]).map(g=>`
          <div class="party-card ${g.id===state.selectedPartyId?'active':''}" data-party-id="${esc(g.id)}">
            <div class="party-card-title"><span>${esc(g.name)}</span><span class="badge b-gray">${Number(g.member_count||0)} คน</span></div>
            <div class="party-card-note">${esc(g.note || 'ไม่มีหมายเหตุ')}</div>
          </div>
        `).join('') || '<div class="sub-muted">ยังไม่มีปาตี้</div>';
      }
      renderPartyMembers();
    }

    function renderPartyMembers(){
      const box = document.getElementById('partyMembersBox');
      const title = document.getElementById('partyMembersTitle');
      const hint = document.getElementById('partyMembersHint');
      const countEl = document.getElementById('partyMemberCount');
      const g = (state.partyGroups||[]).find(x=>x.id===state.selectedPartyId);
      const rows = state.partyMembersByGroup.get(state.selectedPartyId) || [];
      if(title) title.textContent = g ? `รายชื่อในปาตี้: ${g.name}` : 'รายชื่อในปาตี้';
      if(hint) hint.textContent = g ? (g.note || 'จัดกลุ่มลูกค้าเองเพื่อโฟกัสงานต่อ') : 'เลือกปาตี้จากด้านซ้ายก่อน';
      if(countEl) countEl.textContent = rows.length.toLocaleString();
      if(!box) return;
      if(!g){ box.innerHTML = '<div class="sub-muted">ยังไม่ได้เลือกปาตี้</div>'; return; }
      box.innerHTML = rows.map((m,i)=>`
        <div class="party-member-row" data-party-id="${esc(state.selectedPartyId)}" data-opd="${esc(m.opd)}">
          <div class="badge b-gray">#${i+1}</div>
          <div><a class="link" href="javascript:;" onclick="openCustomerModal('OPD:${esc(m.opd)}')">${esc(m.customer_name || '-')}</a><div class="sub-muted">OPD ${esc(m.opd)} • ${esc(m.phone || '-')}</div></div>
          <div><span class="badge b-gray">${esc(String(m.created_at||'').slice(0,10) || '-')}</span></div>
          <input class="party-note-input" data-party-member-note value="${esc(m.note || '')}" placeholder="หมายเหตุเฉพาะคนนี้ในปาตี้">
          <button class="btn btn-ghost" type="button" data-remove-party-member>ลบออก</button>
        </div>
      `).join('') || '<div class="sub-muted">ปาตี้นี้ยังไม่มีลูกค้า</div>';
    }

    function rowsToPartyMembers(rows){
      const out=[]; const seen=new Set();
      for(const r of rows || []){
        const v = r.v || r;
        const opd = pad4(v.opd || r.opd || '');
        if(!opd || seen.has(opd)) continue;
        seen.add(opd);
        out.push({opd, customer_name:v.name || r.name || '', phone:v.phone || r.phone || '', note:''});
      }
      return out;
    }

    async function createPartyFromMembers(members, defaultName=''){
      if(!members.length){ toast('ไม่มีรายชื่อให้สร้างปาตี้', 'warn'); return null; }
      const name = prompt('ตั้งชื่อปาตี้', defaultName || `ปาตี้ ${ymdLocal(new Date())}`);
      if(!name) return null;
      const note = prompt('หมายเหตุปาตี้ (ไม่ใส่ก็ได้)', '') || '';
      const created = await apiParty('/api/party_focus', {
        method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body:JSON.stringify({name, note})
      });
      const gid = created.group?.id;
      if(gid){
        await apiParty(`/api/party_focus/${encodeURIComponent(gid)}/members`, {
          method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
          body:JSON.stringify({members})
        });
      }
      await refreshPartyFocus();
      state.selectedPartyId = gid || '';
      if(gid) await loadPartyMembers(gid);
      renderPartyFocus();
      toast('สร้างปาตี้จากรายชื่อแล้ว', 'ok');
      return gid;
    }

    async function applyPartyFilter(){
      const sel = document.getElementById('partyFilterSelect');
      const partyId = sel?.value || '';
      state.partyFilterId = partyId;
      if(!partyId){
        state.partyFilterOpds = null;
        invalidateCurrentCustomersCache();
        document.getElementById('partyFilterNote').textContent = 'ไม่ได้กรองด้วยปาตี้';
        renderAll();
        return;
      }
      const members = await loadPartyMembers(partyId);
      state.partyFilterOpds = new Set(members.map(m=>pad4(m.opd)).filter(Boolean));
      invalidateCurrentCustomersCache();
      const g = state.partyGroups.find(x=>x.id===partyId);
      document.getElementById('partyFilterNote').textContent = `กำลังวิเคราะห์ปาตี้: ${g?.name || '-'} (${members.length} คน)`;
      renderAll();
      scrollToFinal();
    }

    async function renderCustomerPartyPanel(opd, customerName='', phone=''){
      const box = document.getElementById('modalPartyMembershipBox');
      if(!box) return;
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="sub-muted">กำลังโหลดปาตี้...</div>';
      try{
        const data = await apiParty(`/api/party_focus/customer/${encodeURIComponent(pad4(opd))}`);
        const groups = data.groups || [];
        box.innerHTML = groups.map(g=>`
          <div class="party-membership-item" data-party-id="${esc(g.id)}" data-opd="${esc(opd)}">
            <div class="party-membership-head">
              <label style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:0;font-size:12px;color:#0f172a;">
                <input type="checkbox" data-party-toggle ${g.is_member?'checked':''}> ${esc(g.name)}
              </label>
              <span class="badge ${g.is_member?'b-ok':'b-gray'}">${g.is_member?'อยู่ในปาตี้':'ยังไม่อยู่'}</span>
            </div>
            <input class="party-note-input" data-party-customer-note value="${esc(g.member_note || '')}" placeholder="หมายเหตุเฉพาะลูกค้าคนนี้ในปาตี้นี้" ${g.is_member?'':'disabled'}>
            <div class="sub-muted">${esc(g.note || '')}</div>
          </div>
        `).join('') || '<div class="sub-muted">ยังไม่มีปาตี้ให้เลือก</div>';
        box.querySelectorAll('[data-party-toggle]').forEach(chk=>{
          chk.addEventListener('change', async ()=>{
            const row = chk.closest('.party-membership-item');
            const partyId = row.dataset.partyId;
            const noteInput = row.querySelector('[data-party-customer-note]');
            const action = chk.checked ? 'add' : 'remove';
            await apiParty(`/api/party_focus/customer/${encodeURIComponent(pad4(opd))}`, {
              method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
              body:JSON.stringify({party_id:partyId, action, customer_name:customerName, phone, note:noteInput?.value || ''})
            });
            noteInput.disabled = !chk.checked;
            await refreshPartyFocus();
            await renderCustomerPartyPanel(opd, customerName, phone);
          });
        });
        box.querySelectorAll('[data-party-customer-note]').forEach(inp=>{
          inp.addEventListener('change', async ()=>{
            const row = inp.closest('.party-membership-item');
            if(inp.disabled) return;
            await apiParty(`/api/party_focus/${encodeURIComponent(row.dataset.partyId)}/members/${encodeURIComponent(pad4(opd))}`, {
              method:'PUT', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify({note:inp.value || ''})
            });
            toast('บันทึกหมายเหตุปาตี้แล้ว', 'ok');
          });
        });
      }catch(e){
        box.innerHTML = `<div class="sub-muted">โหลดปาตี้ไม่สำเร็จ: ${esc(e.message)}</div>`;
      }
    }

    async function fetchProfileImage(opd){
      const opd4 = pad4(opd);
      const masterUrl = state.customerDataByOpd.get(opd4)?.profile_pic_url || '';
      if(masterUrl) return masterUrl;
      try{
        const res = await fetch(`/api/get_gallery?opd=${encodeURIComponent(opd4)}`);
        if(!res.ok) return '';
        const rows = await res.json();
        const arr = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : (rows.images || rows.data || []);
        const profile = arr.find(x=>x.is_profile || x.image_type==='profile') || arr[0];
        return profile?.image_url || profile?.url || '';
      }catch{return '';}
    }

    document.getElementById('btnCreateParty')?.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
      const name = document.getElementById('partyNameInput').value.trim();
      const note = document.getElementById('partyNoteInput').value.trim();
      if(!name){ toast('ใส่ชื่อปาตี้ก่อน', 'warn'); return; }
      try{
        const data = await apiParty('/api/party_focus', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify({name,note})});
        state.selectedPartyId = data.group?.id || '';
        document.getElementById('partyNameInput').value='';
        document.getElementById('partyNoteInput').value='';
        await refreshPartyFocus();
        renderPartyFocus();
        toast('สร้างปาตี้แล้ว', 'ok');
      }catch(e){ toast('สร้างปาตี้ไม่สำเร็จ: '+e.message, 'err'); }
    });

    document.getElementById('partyListBox')?.addEventListener('click', async (e)=>{
      const card = e.target.closest('.party-card[data-party-id]');
      if(!card) return;
      state.selectedPartyId = card.dataset.partyId;
      await loadPartyMembers(state.selectedPartyId);
      renderPartyFocus();
    });

    document.getElementById('partyMembersBox')?.addEventListener('click', async (e)=>{
      const btn = e.target.closest('[data-remove-party-member]');
      if(!btn) return;
      const row = btn.closest('.party-member-row');
      if(!row) return;
      await apiParty(`/api/party_focus/${encodeURIComponent(row.dataset.partyId)}/members/${encodeURIComponent(row.dataset.opd)}`, {method:'DELETE'});
      await refreshPartyFocus();
      await loadPartyMembers(row.dataset.partyId);
      renderPartyFocus();
      toast('ลบออกจากปาตี้แล้ว', 'ok');
    });
    document.getElementById('partyMembersBox')?.addEventListener('change', async (e)=>{
      const inp = e.target.closest('[data-party-member-note]');
      if(!inp) return;
      const row = inp.closest('.party-member-row');
      await apiParty(`/api/party_focus/${encodeURIComponent(row.dataset.partyId)}/members/${encodeURIComponent(row.dataset.opd)}`, {method:'PUT', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify({note:inp.value||''})});
      toast('บันทึกหมายเหตุแล้ว', 'ok');
    });

    document.getElementById('btnApplyPartyFilter')?.addEventListener('click', ()=>applyPartyFilter().catch(e=>toast(e.message,'err')));
    document.getElementById('btnClearPartyFilter')?.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      state.partyFilterId=''; state.partyFilterOpds=null;
      const sel=document.getElementById('partyFilterSelect'); if(sel) sel.value='';
      document.getElementById('partyFilterNote').textContent='ล้างปาตี้แล้ว';
      renderAll();
    });
    document.getElementById('btnSaveCurrentToParty')?.addEventListener('click', ()=>createPartyFromMembers(rowsToPartyMembers(state.finalRows), 'ปาตี้จากผลที่ซอส'));
    document.getElementById('btnAddVisibleToSelectedParty')?.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
      if(!state.selectedPartyId){ toast('เลือกปาตี้ก่อน', 'warn'); return; }
      const members = rowsToPartyMembers(state.finalRows);
      if(!members.length){ toast('ไม่มีรายชื่อที่กำลังแสดง', 'warn'); return; }
      await apiParty(`/api/party_focus/${encodeURIComponent(state.selectedPartyId)}/members`, {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify({members})});
      await refreshPartyFocus(); await loadPartyMembers(state.selectedPartyId); renderPartyFocus();
      toast(`เพิ่ม ${members.length} คนเข้าปาตี้แล้ว`, 'ok');
    });
    document.getElementById('btnDeleteSelectedParty')?.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
      if(!state.selectedPartyId){ toast('เลือกปาตี้ก่อน', 'warn'); return; }
      const g = state.partyGroups.find(x=>x.id===state.selectedPartyId);
      if(!confirm(`ลบปาตี้ "${g?.name||''}" ใช่ไหม?`)) return;
      await apiParty(`/api/party_focus/${encodeURIComponent(state.selectedPartyId)}`, {method:'DELETE'});
      state.selectedPartyId=''; await refreshPartyFocus(); renderPartyFocus();
      toast('ลบปาตี้แล้ว', 'ok');
    });
    document.getElementById('btnExportPartyMembers')?.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const rows = state.partyMembersByGroup.get(state.selectedPartyId) || [];
      if(!rows.length){ toast('ไม่มีสมาชิกให้ export', 'warn'); return; }
      const lines = [['OPD','Name','Phone','Note'], ...rows.map(r=>[r.opd||'', r.customer_name||'', r.phone||'', r.note||''])];
      const csv = lines.map(row=>row.map(c=>`"${String(c??'').replace(/"/g,'""')}"`).join(',')).join('\n');
      const blob = new Blob(['\ufeff', csv], {type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a=document.createElement('a');
      a.href=url; a.download=`party_focus_${ymdLocal(new Date())}.csv`; a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    });

    /* Range chip UI uses same data-range hooks */
    document.getElementById('openCustomRange')?.addEventListener('click', openRangeModal);

    /* Init */
    initViewTabs();
    initProductInsight();
    (async function init(){
      showLoading(true);
      try{
        // ยอดขายเป็นข้อมูลแกนหลัก ต้องมาก่อน
        await loadAllSales();

        // รอข้อมูลลูกค้า/สี/วันเกิดให้เสร็จก่อน render ครั้งแรก เพื่อไม่ให้
        // สีลูกค้าและสถิติช่วงอายุขึ้นไม่ครบจาก race condition
        const optionalResults = await Promise.allSettled([
          loadAllProfiles(),
          loadProductEstimatedPrices(),
          refreshPartyFocus()
        ]);
        optionalResults.forEach((result, index)=>{
          if(result.status === 'rejected'){
            const names = ['profiles','product-settings','party-focus'];
            console.warn(`[customer-list] ${names[index]} load failed`, result.reason);
          }
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.chip[data-range]').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('active'));
        const allChip = document.querySelector('.chip[data-range="all"]');
        if(allChip) allChip.classList.add('active');
        setQuickRange('all');
        applyRange();
        toast('โหลดข้อมูลเรียบร้อย', 'ok');
      }catch(e){
        console.error('[customer-list] core load failed', e);
        const workspace = document.getElementById('customerListWorkspace');
        if(workspace){
          const warn = document.createElement('div');
          warn.className = 'customer-list-fatal';
          warn.innerHTML = '<b>โหลดข้อมูลยอดขายไม่สำเร็จ</b><span>ข้อมูลส่วนอื่นยังไม่ถูกลบ กรุณารีเฟรชหน้าอีกครั้ง</span>';
          workspace.prepend(warn);
        }
        toast('โหลดข้อมูลหลักไม่สำเร็จ', 'err', 5000);
      }finally{
        showLoading(false);
      }
    })();

    /* ==========================
       NOTE: ฟังก์ชัน global ที่ถูกเรียกจาก HTML
       ========================== */
    window.openDashboardFullscreen = openDashboardFullscreen;
    window.closeDashboardFullscreen = closeDashboardFullscreen;
    window.openCustomerModal = openCustomerModal;
    window.closeCustomerModal = closeCustomerModal;
    window.openPitchModalForOPD = openPitchModalForOPD;
    window.closePitchModal = closePitchModal;
    window.openRangeModal = openRangeModal;
    window.closeRangeModal = closeRangeModal;
    window.applyRangeFromModal = applyRangeFromModal;
    window.applyRecency = applyRecency;
    window.applyABC = applyABC;
    window.applyRFM = applyRFM;
    window.applyNameColorFilter = applyNameColorFilter;
    window.applyPitchOutcomeFilter = applyPitchOutcomeFilter;
    window.applySpend = applySpend;
    window.removeFilterLayer = removeFilterLayer;
    window.editFilterLayer = editFilterLayer;
    window.clearFilterLayers = clearFilterLayers;
    window.saveEstimatedPriceByKey = saveEstimatedPriceByKey;
    window.applyWeekdayDetail = applyWeekdayDetail;
    window.applyAgeBucket = applyAgeBucket;
  </script>

  <script>(function(){
  'use strict';

  const BLANK_AVATAR = '';
  let current = { opd: '', data: null, pitchLoaded: false, pitchOffset: 0 };
  let unassignedLibraryItems = [];
  const oldOpenCustomerModal = window.openCustomerModal;
  const oldCloseCustomerModal = window.closeCustomerModal;

  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  const clean = (s) => String(s ?? '').trim();
  const normalizeFatCategoryText = (s) => clean(s).replace(/Fat\s*\/\s*Hifu\s*\/\s*ปากกา/gi, 'ลดไขมัน').replace(/Fat\s*\/\s*Hifu/gi, 'ลดไขมัน');
  const fmtMoney = (v) => Math.round(Number(v || 0)).toLocaleString();
  const fmtDate = (d) => {
    const s = String(d || '').slice(0,10);
    if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)) return '-';
    const [y,m,day] = s.split('-');
    return `${day}/${m}/${String(y).slice(-2)}`;
  };
  const pad4 = (v) => {
    const raw = String(v ?? '').trim();
    if(!raw) return '';
    const digits = raw.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if(!digits) return '';
    const opd = digits.padStart(4, '0').slice(-4);
    return opd === '0000' ? '' : opd;
  };
  const decodeKey = (raw) => {
    const s = String(raw ?? '');
    try { return decodeURIComponent(s); } catch { return s; }
  };


  const NAME_COLOR_LABELS = { green: 'เขียว', orange: 'ส้ม', red: 'แดง', gold: 'ทอง VIP' };
  const NAME_COLOR_NOTES = { green: 'ปกติ', orange: 'ระวัง', red: 'Blacklist', gold: 'VIP หมอดูแลเอง' };
  let nameColorMap = {};
  let nameColorPromise = null;
  let nameColorObserver = null;

  function normalizeNameColor(value){
    const c = clean(value).toLowerCase();
    if(c === 'ทอง' || c === 'vip' || c === 'golden') return 'gold';
    return (c === 'red' || c === 'orange' || c === 'green' || c === 'gold') ? c : 'green';
  }
  function colorClass(color){ return `name-color-${normalizeNameColor(color)}`; }
  function customerColorByOpd(opd){
    const o = pad4(opd);
    return normalizeNameColor(nameColorMap[o]?.name_color || 'green');
  }
  function customerColorNoteByOpd(opd){
    const o = pad4(opd);
    return clean(nameColorMap[o]?.name_color_note || '');
  }
  function customerColorFromData(data){
    const c = data?.customer || {};
    return normalizeNameColor(c.name_color || nameColorMap[pad4(data?.opd)]?.name_color || 'green');
  }
  function customerColorNoteFromData(data){
    const c = data?.customer || {};
    return clean(c.name_color_note || nameColorMap[pad4(data?.opd)]?.name_color_note || '');
  }

  async function loadCustomerNameColors(force=false){
    if(nameColorPromise && !force) return nameColorPromise;
    nameColorPromise = fetch('/api/customer_name_colors', {credentials:'same-origin'})
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => {
        nameColorMap = data && data.colors ? data.colors : {};
        applyCustomerNameColors(document);
        return data;
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.warn('โหลดสีชื่อลูกค้าไม่สำเร็จ:', err);
        nameColorMap = nameColorMap || {};
        return {schema_ready:false, colors:{}};
      });
    return nameColorPromise;
  }

  function decodeHtmlAttrText(s){
    return String(s || '')
      .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
      .replace(/&#34;/g, '"')
      .replace(/&#39;/g, "'")
      .replace(/&apos;/g, "'")
      .replace(/&amp;/g, '&');
  }

  function opdFromOpenCustomerCall(text){
    const raw0 = decodeHtmlAttrText(text || '');
    if(!raw0) return '';

    const candidates = [raw0];
    try {
      const decoded = decodeURIComponent(raw0);
      if(decoded && decoded !== raw0) candidates.push(decoded);
    } catch(_) {}

    // รองรับทั้ง openCustomerModal('OPD:0025'), openCustomerModal('opd%3A0025'),
    // openCustomerProfile('0025'), data-open-profile และ onclick ที่ฝัง key แบบ OPD:xxxx
    const patterns = [
      /(?:OPD|opd)\s*:\s*([0-9]{1,8})/i,
      /(?:OPD|opd)%3A([0-9]{1,8})/i,
      /openCustomer(?:Modal|Profile)\(\s*['"]\s*(?:OPD|opd)\s*:\s*([0-9]{1,8})/i,
      /openCustomer(?:Modal|Profile)\(\s*['"]\s*([0-9]{1,8})\s*['"]/i,
      /data-(?:open-profile|customer-opd|name-color-opd|opd)\s*=\s*['"]?([0-9]{1,8})/i
    ];
    for(const raw of candidates){
      for(const re of patterns){
        const m = raw.match(re);
        if(m && m[1]) return pad4(m[1]);
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

  function readOpdFromElement(el){
    if(!el) return '';
    const own = el.dataset?.customerOpd || el.dataset?.nameColorOpd || el.dataset?.openProfile || el.dataset?.opd || '';
    if(own) return pad4(own);

    const onclick = el.getAttribute?.('onclick') || '';
    const fromClick = opdFromOpenCustomerCall(onclick);
    if(fromClick) return fromClick;

    const href = el.getAttribute?.('href') || '';
    const fromHref = opdFromOpenCustomerCall(href);
    if(fromHref) return fromHref;

    const row = el.closest?.('[data-customer-opd],[data-name-color-opd],[data-open-profile],[data-opd]');
    if(row){
      const v = row.dataset?.customerOpd || row.dataset?.nameColorOpd || row.dataset?.openProfile || row.dataset?.opd || '';
      if(v) return pad4(v);
      const rowClick = row.getAttribute?.('onclick') || '';
      const fromRowClick = opdFromOpenCustomerCall(rowClick);
      if(fromRowClick) return fromRowClick;
    }
    return '';
  }

  function isCustomerNameTarget(el){
    if(!el || !el.matches) return false;
    return el.matches([
      '.customer-name-color',
      '.dashboard-mini-name',
      '.debtor-summary-name',
      '.pending-name',
      '.customer-name',
      '.name',
      'a.link',
      'a[onclick*="openCustomer"]',
      'span[onclick*="openCustomer"]',
